Sentence (English): Review of the LG Dios Objet Collection Dishwasher DUE1BGLE.
Comments (English): [ I wonder why I only bought this now. ] || ---------------- || Review of the LG Dios Objet Collection Dishwasher DUE1BGLE. It's fine when I don't have a lot of dishes to wash, but after having guests over, the pile of dishes always makes me sigh. So, after much deliberation, I bought one, and after using it, I understand why dishwashers are called "quality-of-life appliances." It's especially helpful when I'm having guests over and doing the dishes. Since I can load and spin the dishes, including plates, cups, and utensils, all at once, I can clean up right away after a meal without the stress of washing dishes. It used to take me hours to stand in the kitchen doing the dishes, but now I can just load the dishes and press a button, which frees up time for family conversation. The dishwasher's cleaning power is also surprisingly good, cleaning even greasy dishes and soup bowls cleanly. The dryer also means there are almost no water stains and the dishes are ready to be put away right away, which is convenient. The interior is spacious, so I can store a lot of plates and cups, and once I get used to the dish arrangement, I can clean up quickly. It's also quiet, so I didn't mind running it at night. If there's one downside, it's that it takes a bit of practice to get used to how to arrange dishes when first using it, and overly large pots and pans can be difficult to clean depending on their location, so careful arrangement is necessary. Still, overall, it's a highly satisfying appliance that significantly reduces dishwashing time and makes kitchen work much easier. I personally highly recommend this product to anyone who cooks a lot at home or frequently hosts guests. I think it's a highly satisfactory choice for anyone looking to reduce the stress of dishwashing.

Sentence (English): I have had my new Bosch SHE41CM6N dishwasher for about a month.
Comments (English): [ Not as good as expected ] || ---------------- || I have had my new Bosch SHE41CM6N dishwasher for about a month. It cleans very well and I like the simple control panel and the stainless steel interior. I am disappointed by a few things though. The basket for silverware, etc is quite flimsy and the openings for items only accomodate thin handles; even table knives don't fir in some of them. I wish I would have kept the baskets from my old dishwasher because they held more iems and I could put spatulas, ladles and other larger items in them and they'd get clean. Laying a ladle down in the top rack does not get it clean unless you thoroughly clean it first. MY husband snipped a couple of the dividers with a wire cutter so I could fit a few larger handle items in, but I wish I'd kept my old baskets and used them--much more convenient. (It was a 7 yr old GE and cost to repair was too much) The top rack is not configured to hold as many items as my old dishwasher did and plastic items do not seem to dry as well even with rinse aid. As I stated, it cleans very well, even with plates in every available place in the bottom rack. That's impressive.

My only 'concern' is tied to the drying cycle. I often open the dishwasher to find most of the dishes, especially in the upper rack, still wet, whether crystal dry is on or not. Sentence (English): I was worried about needing a larger size for two people, but my friends who use dishwashers say they're great with larger ones, so I bought a larger one.

Sentence (English): Our previous dishwasher was a KitchenAid that was 25 years old.
Comments (English): [ Great dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || Our previous dishwasher was a KitchenAid that was 25 years old. An interior plastic wash arm on the top of the old unit gave out. Even though my husband was able to sort of fix it we decided that it was time to look at new dishwashers. After opening and closing and checking racks we decided on the KitchenAid 360. We liked the configuration of the interior especially the top rack which has a deeper section for larger, odd shaped kitchen utensils. Also the racks felt sturdier and slid more smoothly compared to other brands. But the best feature of all is the automatic open (yes the door pops open on its own) at the end of the cleaning cycle. The dishes dry by evaporation. It's the best feature and we were pleasantly surprised at how well it works. By the way, the dishes come out clean. We did not use the heated dry on our old unit and haven't on this one. Very happy with this unit.

Comments (English): [ Do NOT Buy! Warranty service is TERRIBLE!  ] || ---------------- || I purchased this dishwasher in October 2025 and loved it until it suddenly stopped working after 3 months. Since it was still under the initial warranty I had to use a service company that KitchenAid has a contract with and not my local appliance repair company whom I purchased this from. A technician diagnosed the problem as a faulty control panel and had to order the part. After 2 weeks he returned to replace the control panel only to tell me it wasn't actually the control panel - it was the wiring harness which again he had to order. After multiple calls to both KitchenAid and the repair company, with no updates over the course of a week, I was told the wiring harness is backordered. This started another process of endless phone calls and total frustration spanning another 3 weeks. (Tip: if you ever want to actually talk to someone at KitchenAid call in the morning, otherwise you will be on hold forever, and they will either never pick up or will "accidentally" disconnect you. But you do get to listen to an endless loop of REALLY annoying music while you are on hold.) At this point I just want them to replace the dishwasher but their policy is 3 repair attempts before they will replace it? I am now going on 7 weeks without a dishwasher with no end in sight. I purchased a KitchenAid because of their reputation and quality but I am beyond frustrated and will NEVER buy another KitchenAid or Whirlpool product (same company) again!

Sentence (English): We had a Bosch 500 series for years and were very pleased with how quiet it ran, the awesome 3rd rack and how well it cleaned the dishes.
Comments (English): [ Surprised - Frustrated ] || ---------------- || We had a Bosch 500 series for years and were very pleased with how quiet it ran, the awesome 3rd rack and how well it cleaned the dishes. We recently purchased an 800 series. It washes well, runs a little quieter than our old one an has that 3rd rack I now cannot do without. If I had to buy it all over again I really don't think I would. The little aggravation is the 1 janky silverware basket that now comes with it. The tops of the basket don't provide enough spaces for all of your silverware if you have a big family or wait until your dishwasher is full to run it. (They also seem to let your silverware fall around willy nilly.) If you open and don't use the 'tops' of the basket the silverware basket is so short not all of the silverware will stay in place. You may not have room in the very top rack to put the additional silverware. My plan is to buy 2 new silverware baskets that are not made by Bosch. (I wish I would have kept my old ones.). The 2nd thing that really makes me regret purchasing this dishwasher is that even though we leveled up and bought a nicer dishwasher with more options, we don't have access to all of those options unless we connect our dishwasher to wifi. The very basic options are available on the dishwasher itself but the extra options we were looking forward to are only available through the app - you cannot use the app without connecting your dishwasher to the internet and cloud. Ridiculous. There is now a blinking red light for 'machine care' and you're supposed to use their special detergent and use the machine care cycle to disinfect the dishwasher. Not a bad idea, but the there is no machine care button on my 800 dishwasher. It's on the app. I guess it will be blinking for the next 7-10 years - if I can handle it that long. SO VERY FRUSTRATING.

We recently purchased an 800 series. It washes well, runs a little quieter than our old one an has that 3rd rack I now cannot do without. If I had to buy it all over again I really don't think I would. The little aggravation is the 1 janky silverware basket that now comes with it. The tops of the basket don't provide enough spaces for all of your silverware if you have a big family or wait until your dishwasher is full to run it. (They also seem to let your silverware fall around willy nilly.) If you open and don't use the 'tops' of the basket the silverware basket is so short not all of the silverware will stay in place. You may not have room in the very top rack to put the additional silverware. My plan is to buy 2 new silverware baskets that are not made by Bosch. (I wish I would have kept my old ones.). The 2nd thing that really makes me regret purchasing this dishwasher is that even though we leveled up and bought a nicer dishwasher with more options, we don't have access to all of those options unless we connect our dishwasher to wifi. The very basic options are available on the dishwasher itself but the extra options we were looking forward to are only available through the app - you cannot use the app without connecting your dishwasher to the internet and cloud. Ridiculous. There is now a blinking red light for 'machine care' and you're supposed to use their special detergent and use the machine care cycle to disinfect the dishwasher. Not a bad idea, but the there is no machine care button on my 800 dishwasher. It's on the app. I guess it will be blinking for the next 7-10 years - if I can handle it that long. SO VERY FRUSTRATING.

Sentence (English): We had a Bosch 500 series for years and were very pleased with how quiet it ran, the awesome 3rd rack and how well it cleaned the dishes.
Comments (English): [ Surprised - Frustrated ] || ---------------- || We had a Bosch 500 series for years and were very pleased with how quiet it ran, the awesome 3rd rack and how well it cleaned the dishes. We recently purchased an 800 series. It washes well, runs a little quieter than our old one an has that 3rd rack I now cannot do without. If I had to buy it all over again I really don't think I would. The little aggravation is the single janky silverware basket that now comes with it. The tops of the basket don't provide enough spaces for all of your silverware if you have a big family or wait until your dishwasher is full to run it. (They also seem to let your silverware fall around willy nilly.) If you open and don't use the 'tops' of the basket the silverware basket is so short not all of the silverware will stay in place. You may not have room in the very top rack to put the additional silverware. My plan is to buy 2 new silverware baskets that are not made by Bosch. (I wish I would have kept my old ones.). The 2nd thing that REALLY makes me regret purchasing this dishwasher is that even though we leveled up and bought a nicer dishwasher with more options, we don't have access to all of those options unless we connect our dishwasher to wifi. The very basic options are available on the dishwasher itself but the extra options we were looking forward to are only available through the app - you cannot use the app without connecting your dishwasher to the internet and cloud. Ridiculous. There is now a blinking red light for 'machine care' and you're supposed to use their special detergent and use the machine care cycle to disinfect the dishwasher. Not a bad idea, but the there is no machine care button on my 800 dishwasher. It's on the app. I guess it will be blinking for the next 7-10 years - if I can handle it that long. SO VERY FRUSTRATING.

Sentence (English): And dry ones, too.
Comments (English): [ Finally, clean dishes! ] || ---------------- || And dry ones, too. I was initially reluctant to pay for a higher model, but was convinced by the additional drying technology in the 800. My top-rack plastics are dryer than they were in our old dishwasher when the cycle ends. My only dissatisfactions were that I didn't seem to have access to meaningful documentation till I downloaded the HomeConnect app. The app connected to the dishwasher easily, but initially I couldn't figure out how to operate the dishwasher with the control panel on the unit. It did not seem to work as the paper guide described. It's also not clear to me that you can use the delayed start function without the app. So, there's a learning curve to using it, but the good news is that it's far less finicky than our previous dishwashers about how it's loaded. Of course, the real ROI is going to be in its longevity, but I'm hoping that Bosch's reputation will prove true.

Sentence (English): I was sorry when the controls on my old Bosh dishwasher of 17 years stopped working.
Comments (English): [ Note as good as my old Bosh dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I was sorry when the controls on my old Bosh dishwasher of 17 years stopped working. Not sure if it would have been fixable. I decided to get a new one and not have it fixed because the life expectancy of my old dishwasher was at max 18 years. The new one is quiet but some of the features are strange. The upper rack with silverware is a pain. I prefer to put them in the lower silverware bin but it is now too small to accomidate very many pieces. Also, the inside of the machine is always wet when the dishes are done. I'm sure it won't be long before that gets moldy. Fingers crossed that is not an issue. I keep reading stuff about someday needing to add salt to the machine to make it dry. What the heck? My old one dried perfect everytime without any additives. The manual is not very clear about this issue.The one good thing is the machine is very quiet but so was my old one. The racks seem VERY wobbley and flimsy when I pull the out. I will use extra TLC to not have them break. I used to be able to put mugs on the top rack and still use the pull down above it to lay a long utensil. With this feature they shortened the space between rack and pull down so you can only use very short items below it. Also, there is no indicator light that lets you know if your dishes are clean. My old machine had a light on it that let you know the washing and drying part was the dishes were clean until you shut off the light. The new one only has a light that indicates it is either on or off. We rinse are dishes off before putting them in the dishwasher so now if the light is off we have to decide if one of us turned the machine on and they are all clean, or are these dirty dishes still needing to be cleaned. Yes we could use some magnetic reminder on the front that we have to use but that destroys the beauty of the front of the machine. It is a pretty machine. But so was our last one. I will adapt to all the little things I am disappointed with as long as the machine lasts another 17 years with no problems like my last Bosch.

Sentence (English): Our previous dishwasher was a KitchenAid that was 25 years old.
Comments (English): [ Great dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || Our previous dishwasher was a KitchenAid that was 25 years old. An interior plastic wash arm on the top of the old unit gave out. Even though my husband was able to sort of fix it we decided that it was time to look at new dishwashers. After opening and closing and . checking racks we decided on the KitchenAid 360. We liked the configuration of the interior especially the top rack which has a deeper section for larger, odd shaped kitchen utensils. Also the racks felt sturdier and slid more smoothly compared to other brands. But the best feature of all is the automatic open (yes the door pops open on its own) at the end of the cleaning cycle. The dishes dry by evaporation. It's the best feature and we were pleasantly surprised at how well it works. By the way, the dishes come out clean. We did not use the heated dry on our old unit and haven't on this one. Very happy with this unit.

Sentence (English): I highly recommend this to anyone looking to lighten their kitchen load.
Comments (English): [ Kitchen essentials, dishwashing relief items ] || ---------------- || While organizing my kitchen appliances, I finally purchased Samsung's Bespoke 6-seater countertop dishwasher after much deliberation. As a family of four with two children, we wash a ton of dishes every day. Especially after dinner, the sink quickly fills up with dishes, cups, spoons, and even the kids' snack plates, which was always stressful. So, instead of a large built-in dishwasher, I opted for a countertop dishwasher that takes up less space. First of all, the design is truly beautiful. True to the Bespoke line, it has a clean, modern feel that doesn't detract from the kitchen's interior, but rather enhances it. It makes my kitchen feel more organized, which is very satisfying. The dishwasher is designed for six people, so it's more than enough for a family of four to eat dinner. While pots and pans may need to be adjusted depending on size, there's plenty of room for regular dishes. The dishwashing power also exceeded my expectations. It cleans even greasy pans and seasoned dishes cleanly, eliminating the need for a separate pre-wash. The high-temperature wash function keeps things hygienic, which is especially reassuring when handling the kids' dishes. The drying function was better than I expected, so any residual moisture wasn't a major inconvenience, and it dries quickly if you leave the door open. It's also relatively quiet. It's not so noisy that it's annoying even when running at night, so I set a timer and run it before bed. It also uses less water than hand washing, which is a nice environmental benefit. Installation wasn't as difficult as I thought, and as long as you have enough space next to the sink, you'll be able to use it. However, I recommend checking the drain connection location in advance. Large pots and concave bowls require some skill in placement. After a few uses, I naturally got the hang of it. Overall, I'm glad I bought this appliance. With less time washing dishes, I have more free time in the evenings and more time to take care of my kids. I highly recommend this to anyone looking to lighten their kitchen load. Every light and button was illuminated on the panel though nothing responded. I realized I only had a few weeks left of my 2 year warranty, so called for a repairman. Worthless, carelessness on Bosch's part in the website coding. I'm not alone. It's well documented online and even detailed in chatGPT! Ok, I'll call. Each time it said there would be a 45 minute wait! Finally, calling in the evening, I got through and got a reschedule. I used to think Bosch was a high quality name and even have many of their tools. No longer. This washer was really barely used. Maybe 30 or 40 times at most before it just died for no reason. That means it cost me around $50 to wash each load! It's still not fixed and I don't know if they plan to give me distress about the warranty so it still might cost me hundreds out of pocket. We'll see. Costco, as always is fantastic. But after this I will never buy anything that Bosch makes. Over-priced, unexpected failure and horrible customer service and expediency. Look elsewhere

Sentence (English): I am incredibly disappointed with Bosch and Lowe's.
Comments (English): [ Three dishwashers, each one with moldy racks ] || ---------------- || I am incredibly disappointed with Bosch and Lowe's. I ordered a brand new 500 Series Bosch dishwasher and had it delivered to my home so I could install it. After unwrapping the plastic and opening it, there was obvious black spots on the racks inside, especially the top rack (see photos). It looked like mold. Even a piece of paper that comes inside had mold on it. I understand that Bosch tests the dishwashers in the factory and a little bit of water is normal, but this was more than just water. I worked with Lowe's for an exchange, and the second dishwasher also had mold on the racks. I called for another exchange, and the THIRD dishwasher had mold on the top rack. I temporarily installed the third dishwasher and ran several cleaning cycles with regular detergent, and with Affresh cleaning tablets; the mold lightened up but was still present. A brand new appliance >$1100 should be perfectly clean, and given the state of the racks I did not trust the rest of the internal parts. I shouldn't have to work to clean a brand new product that is disgusting. (I also wonder how many Bosches are delivered and installed by a pro and get cleaned up before customers see them.) A Bosch agent said over the phone that the mold was surprising and I should return for a refund and buy another brand(? ). Returning the third dishwasher and getting a refund from Lowe's was much more difficult than it needed to be because their Denver warehouse was really uncommunicative, especially when I hit their unstated "limit" of 3 exchanges. I then went to a local appliance chain and had a MUCH better experience. Despite the issues I had with Bosch dishwashers from Lowe's, I apparently never learn and bought an 800 Series from the local chain - and IT was moldy too, in exactly the same way! This is where I especially blame Bosch and their poor quality control. I'll also say from all the handling of these dishwashers, I think Bosch dishwashers these days are flimsier and feel cheaper than the ones I have experience with at family members' houses that were installed 10+ years ago. They are just not great products anymore.So I returned that last Bosch (easy peasy with the local store) and bought a Miele from the local store instead. I couldn't be happier. It was a little more expensive, but it looks good, feels good during handling, cleans well, is dependable, and most importantly, it came out of the packaging CLEAN! Do not buy Bosch. Check around and you will see other reviews here and at other box stores that mention mold in Bosches. Bosch will comment on the reviews saying to call them, which I tried and found to be totally unhelpful. See ya never!

Sentence (English): After having a Bosch dishwasher for years, we decided to install a fully equipped kitchen with built-in appliances when we moved six years ago.
Comments (English): [ Home sweet home ] || ---------------- || After having a Bosch dishwasher for years, we decided to install a fully equipped kitchen with built-in appliances when we moved six years ago. Because we were under time pressure, we left the choice of built-in appliances to the installer, with the brief: they had to be good, but not necessarily the most expensive. The dishwasher wasn't a Bosch, but a different four-letter brand that also makes many household appliances. From day one, we didn't have a good feeling about the dishwasher. The baskets started rusting after just a few months (replaced under warranty), and the dishes weren't drying properly. But hey, what's bought is bought, so we tried not to let that bother us too much. Over time, the poor drying became an increasing annoyance. We also increasingly thought back to the Bosch dryer we'd used for years in our previous house to our complete satisfaction. One thing was clear: if our current dishwasher broke, the new one would be a Bosch again! After the door lock (spring and cable system) on my current dishwasher broke twice, the second time a guide roller, including the mounting, broke, and this wasn't available as a spare part, I quickly decided: a new dishwasher is on the way! After reading numerous reviews of various dishwasher brands, I quickly decided to buy a Bosch dishwasher. Why? Well, I was actually longing for the satisfaction of our first Bosch dishwasher. Because of Bosch's new drying technology (Zeolith) and its energy efficiency (A-label), I chose this Bosch dishwasher. Because I'm quite handy, I decided to install it myself. The clear instructions made it a simple job. Now, having installed it myself and using it, I feel incredibly satisfied. Just like with our first Bosch, back to the old nest, as they say, or something like home sweet home.
Comments (Original): [ Home sweet home ] || ---------------- || Na jaren een Bosch vaatwasser te hebben gehad hebben we bij onze verhuizing 6 jaar geleden gekozen voor het plaatsen van een compleet ingerichte keuken met inbouwapparatuur. Omdat de verhuizing onder tijdsdruk stond hebben we de keuze voor de inbouwapparatuur over gelaten aan de installateur met als opdracht, het moet goed zijn maar niet perse het allerduurste.. De vaatwasser werd geen Bosch maar een ander 4 letterig merk welke ook veel huishoudelijk apparatuur maakt. Vanaf dag  1 eigenlijk al geen goed gevoel gehad bij de vaatwasser. De korven begonnen al na een paar maanden te roesten (onder garantie vernieuwd) en de vaat werd niet goed droog. Maar ja, gekocht is gekocht.. dus proberen ons daar niet teveel aan te storen. Door de tijd heen begon het niet goed drogen een steeds grotere ergenis te worden. Daarbij steeds vaker terug gedacht aan de Bosch droger welke wij jaren naar alle tevredenheid hadden gebruikt in ons vorige huis.1 ding dus duidelijk, als onze huidige vaatwasser een stuk  zou gaan zou de nieuwe weer een Bosch worden!Nadat de deursluiting ( veer en kabelsysteem) van de huidge vaatwasser tot 2 x toe stuk was gegaan, waarbij de 2e keer een geleiderol, inclusief bevestiging was gesneuveld en deze niet als onderdeel leverbaar was, heel snel de beslissing genomen....er komt een nieuwe vaatwasser!! Na vele revieuws te hebben gelezen van verschillende merken vaatwassers eigenlijk heel snel de beslissing genomen een Bosch vaatwasser aan te schaffen. Waarom? Nou eigenlijk verlangend naar het tevreden gevoel van onze eerste Bosch vaatwasser. In combinatie met de nieuwe droogtechniek van Bosch ( Zeolith) en het zuinige energiegebruik ( A-label) gekozen voor deze Bosch vaatwasser. Omdat ik redelijk handig ben gekozen voor het zelf installeren. Door de duidelijke handleiding een eenvoudige klus. Nu, zelf geinstalleerd en in gebruik, een bijzonder tevreden gevoel..... zoals ook met onze eerste Bosch, terug op het oude nest zeggen ze wel...of zoiets van home sweet home.......

The large size, which can accommodate 14 people, allows for ample storage for pots, frying pans, and dishes, making it easy to clean up after a meal! The cleaning power exceeded my expectations, completely removing even greasy dishes and stains, and drying them cleanly without water stains, making it feel more hygienic than washing dishes by hand. Most satisfying of all, the reduced time and effort spent washing dishes has given me more freedom in my day. Comments (English): [ Finally, Auntie Dishwasher came to our house! ] || ---------------- || A quick feeling. Freedom from washing dishes! It's so convenient to have a dishwasher! ^^. User review. Since I often eat at home for health reasons, I used to have to wash dishes multiple times a day, which was a burden. When I was healthy, it felt like nothing, but when I'm a little tired, washing dishes becomes a big task! Using a dishwasher has definitely made my life much easier. First of all, the design is clean and luxurious, as befitting an objet collection, and it matches my kitchen interior very well. It's literally a neat and tidy modern! Another great advantage is that it's available in both freestanding and built-in models, so you can choose the one that best suits your installation environment. I was a little disappointed that the cheaper models were all built-in. I prefer freestanding models! Moving often means remodeling the sink. I prefer installing and using it in an empty space, so even though it's a bit more expensive, I chose a freestanding model! It's cost-effective because I don't have to remodel the sink every time I move! The large size, which can accommodate 14 people, allows for ample storage for pots, frying pans, and dishes, making it easy to clean up after a meal! The cleaning power exceeded my expectations, completely removing even greasy dishes and stains, and drying them cleanly without water stains, making it feel more hygienic than washing dishes by hand. If you want to understand the power of a dishwasher, try washing a delivery container. It's so hard to clean red grease stains by hand, but seeing the container become pristine white is truly a joy! The noise level is low, so I didn't have to worry about using it at night, and the variety of cleaning cycles allows me to choose the right one for my needs. Most satisfying of all, the reduced time and effort spent washing dishes has given me more freedom in my day. Some days, I can just store them all day and run them once in the evening, which is a real plus! If you're considering a dishwasher, don't hesitate! I highly recommend it. Checkpoints and Pros: The large 14-person capacity allows you to wash a family's dishes at once. Powerful cleaning power and thorough drying performance. The sophisticated design, characteristic of Objet Collection. Its versatile design allows for both freestanding and built-in use, making it highly versatile. Its versatile cleaning cycles and ease of use are also included. Its quiet design makes it ideal for nighttime use. Save time washing dishes by hand, improving your quality of life! ^^. * Checkpoints and Cons *. Because it's a large-capacity product, ensure you have ample space for installation. The initial purchase price is somewhat high. The usage and dish arrangement can take some getting used to. If my review was helpful to those considering a purchase, I hope it helps!

Sentence (English): Washing dishes at home has become a burden, so I was looking for a compact dishwasher and chose the Samsung BESPOKE 6-seater countertop dishwasher.
Comments (English): Washing dishes at home has become a burden, so I was looking for a compact dishwasher and chose the Samsung BESPOKE 6-seater countertop dishwasher. Unlike typical built-in models, this one simply sits on top of the sink, making it easy to install and maximizing space. Simply connect the water supply and drain hoses, eliminating the need for any additional installation work, making it perfect for tight spaces like apartment kitchens, studio apartments, and newlywed homes. The design is also a good fit. True to Samsung's BESPOKE line, its simple, modern exterior blends seamlessly with any interior. The clean white and beige tones create a refreshing kitchen feel. Its practical size allows it to accommodate a variety of dishes, cups, pots, wine glasses, and more for six people without taking up much space, making it ideal for families. The dishwashing performance exceeded my expectations. Thanks to the dual 3D water jet system, which sprays water simultaneously from the top and bottom, I felt like the water stream evenly touched all my dishes, including plates and cups. The high-temperature, direct-rinsing action also removed grease relatively cleanly. I especially liked the fact that running it immediately after a meal significantly improved the dishwashing efficiency, as it removed grease before it hardened. The sterilization and drying functions were also impressive. The description stated that the high-temperature sterilization function virtually eliminates harmful bacteria, which gave me peace of mind. I also particularly appreciated the fact that the door automatically opens after the wash is finished and hot air dries the dishes, leaving them soft and fluffy. The drying process also seemed to minimize internal steam and odor, so even on plastic dishes, there were virtually no water droplets. Another advantage I noticed during actual use was its relatively quiet operation. It wasn't too noisy, so it didn't bother me while doing other tasks or having conversations in the kitchen. I was worried that it would be noisy, considering it's a compact dishwasher, but it was relatively quiet, which was satisfying. The ease of use was also excellent. It offers a variety of wash cycles, allowing you to choose based on the level of dirt and type of dishware. Sometimes, I simply run the quick cycle, while others, especially those with heavy oil stains, can be run on the standard cycle. The generous detergent and rinse aid dispensers make it easy to add all-in-one detergents. The included cutlery holder and wine glass holder add practicality to the internal layout. Of course, it's not a perfect product. Installation can be tricky depending on the length and location of the drain hose. If the hose is too far from the sink, you may need to extend it. Depending on your kitchen layout, you may need to carefully check the installation location beforehand. While the six-person capacity is a plus, it may be a bit small for a large family, so consider this before purchasing. Nevertheless, I'm very satisfied with this product as an efficient kitchen helper that significantly reduces the stress of daily dishwashing. I highly recommend it, especially for kitchens with limited space, as it offers thorough cleaning, hygienic sterilization and drying, and easy installation.
Comments (Original): 집에서 설거지 시간이 부담스러워져서 소형 식기세척기를 알아보다가 삼성전자 BESPOKE 카운터탑 식기세척기 6인용을 선택했어요. 이 제품은 일반 빌트인 모델과 달리 싱크대 위에 올려놓기만 하면 되는 카운터탑 타입이라 설치가 간편하고 공간 활용도 좋다는 점이 가장 먼저 마음에 들었어요. 빌트인 공사 없이도 간단히 급수·배수 호스를 연결하면 바로 사용할 수 있어서 아파트 주방이나 자취방, 신혼집처럼 공간이 넉넉지 않은 곳에도 딱 맞습니다.  ￼디자인 면에서도 잘 어울렸는데, 삼성의 BESPOKE 라인답게 심플하고 모던한 외관이라 인테리어와도 조화롭게 어울렸어요. 화이트나 베이지 계열로 깔끔해서 주방을 산뜻하게 만들어주는 느낌이에요. 공간을 많이 차지하지 않으면서도 6인용 기준의 접시, 컵, 냄비, 와인잔 등 다양한 식기를 수납할 수 있는 실용적인 크기라 가족 단위로도 충분히 쓸 수 있다는 게 큰 장점입니다.  ￼세척 성능은 기대 이상이었어요. 상하단에서 물살이 동시에 분사되는 듀얼 3D 워터젯 시스템 덕분에 접시나 컵 등 모든 식기에 물살이 골고루 닿는 느낌이 들었고, 고온 직수 세척으로 기름때도 비교적 깨끗하게 제거됐어요. 특히 식사 직후 바로 돌리면 기름이 굳기 전에 세척해 주기 때문에 설거지 효과가 훨씬 좋아진다는 걸 느꼈습니다.  ￼살균과 건조 기능도 인상적이었어요. 99.999% 고온 살균 기능으로 유해균을 거의 제거해 준다는 설명이 있어서 위생적으로도 안심이 되었고, 세척이 끝나면 자동으로 문이 열리며 열풍 건조가 진행되어 물자국 없이 뽀송하게 마무리된다는 점이 특히 마음에 들어요. 건조 과정에서 내부 수증기나 냄새도 덜 남는 느낌이라 플라스틱 식기에서도 물방울 자국이 거의 없었습니다.  ￼실사용에서 느낀 또 하나의 장점은 소음이 상대적으로 적다는 점이에요. 작동 중에도 시끄럽지 않아 주방에서 다른 일을 하거나 대화를 나눌 때 크게 거슬리지 않았어요. 소형 식기세척기라 소음이 클까 걱정했는데, 비교적 조용한 편이라 만족스러웠습니다.  ￼사용 편의성도 괜찮았어요. 다양한 세척 코스가 있어 오염 정도나 식기 종류에 맞춰 선택할 수 있어서, 때로는 빠른 세척 코스로 간단히 돌리고, 기름때가 많은 식기는 표준 코스로 돌리는 식으로 활용하고 있어요. 세제와 린스 투입구가 넉넉해서 올인원 세제를 쓸 때도 쉽게 넣을 수 있고, 수저통과 와인잔 거치대 등이 포함되어 있어 내부 구성도 실용적입니다.  ￼물론 완벽한 제품은 아니에요. 배수 호스 길이나 설치 위치에 따라 설치가 조금 까다로울 수 있고, 싱크대와 너무 떨어진 위치에선 호스를 길게 늘려야 하는 경우도 있더라고요. 주방 구조에 따라선 설치 전 위치를 미리 꼼꼼히 확인하는 게 필요할 것 같아요. 그리고 6인용이라는 점은 장점이지만, 대가족 기준으로는 살짝 모자랄 수 있는 용량이라 이 점도 구매 전 고려할 필요가 있어요.  ￼그래도 저는 매일의 설거지 스트레스를 크게 줄여 준 효율적인 주방 도우미로서 이 제품을 만족스럽게 쓰고 있습니다. 특히 공간이 넉넉하지 않은 주방에서 깔끔한 세척력, 위생적인 살균과 건조, 간편한 설치 방식을 동시에 원하신다면 충분히 추천할 만한 제품이에요.  ￼

Comments (English): Washing dishes at home has become a burden, so I was looking for a compact dishwasher and chose the Samsung BESPOKE 6-seater countertop dishwasher. Unlike typical built-in models, this one simply sits on top of the sink, making it easy to install and maximizing space. Simply connect the water supply and drain hoses, eliminating the need for any additional installation work, making it perfect for tight spaces like apartment kitchens, studio apartments, and newlywed homes. The design is also a good fit. True to Samsung's BESPOKE line, its simple, modern exterior blends seamlessly with any interior. The clean white and beige tones create a refreshing kitchen feel. Its practical size allows it to accommodate a variety of dishes, cups, pots, wine glasses, and more for six people without taking up much space, making it ideal for families. The dishwashing performance exceeded my expectations. The high-temperature, direct-rinsing action also removed grease relatively cleanly. I especially liked the fact that running it immediately after a meal significantly improved the dishwashing efficiency, as it removed grease before it hardened. The sterilization and drying functions were also impressive. The description stated that the high-temperature sterilization function virtually eliminates harmful bacteria, which gave me peace of mind. I also particularly appreciated the fact that the door automatically opens after the wash is finished and hot air dries the dishes, leaving them soft and fluffy. The drying process also seemed to minimize internal steam and odor, so even on plastic dishes, there were virtually no water droplets. It offers a variety of wash cycles, allowing you to choose based on the level of dirt and type of dishware. Sometimes, I simply run the quick cycle, while others, especially those with heavy oil stains, can be run on the standard cycle. Nevertheless, I'm very satisfied with this product as an efficient kitchen helper that significantly reduces the stress of daily dishwashing. I highly recommend it, especially for kitchens with limited space, as it offers thorough cleaning, hygienic sterilization and drying, and easy installation.

Sentence (English): True to Samsung's BESPOKE line, its simple, modern exterior blends seamlessly with any interior.
Comments (English): Washing dishes at home has become a burden, so I was looking for a compact dishwasher and chose the Samsung BESPOKE 6-seater countertop dishwasher. Unlike typical built-in models, this one simply sits on top of the sink, making it easy to install and maximizing space. Simply connect the water supply and drain hoses, eliminating the need for any additional installation work, making it perfect for tight spaces like apartment kitchens, studio apartments, and newlywed homes. The design is also a good fit. True to Samsung's BESPOKE line, its simple, modern exterior blends seamlessly with any interior. The clean white and beige tones create a refreshing kitchen feel. Its practical size allows it to accommodate a variety of dishes, cups, pots, wine glasses, and more for six people without taking up much space, making it ideal for families. The dishwashing performance exceeded my expectations. Thanks to the dual 3D water jet system, which sprays water simultaneously from the top and bottom, I felt like the water stream evenly touched all my dishes, including plates and cups. The high-temperature, direct-rinsing action also removed grease relatively cleanly. I especially liked the fact that running it immediately after a meal significantly improved the dishwashing efficiency, as it removed grease before it hardened. The sterilization and drying functions were also impressive. The description stated that the high-temperature sterilization function virtually eliminates harmful bacteria, which gave me peace of mind. I also particularly appreciated the fact that the door automatically opens after the wash is finished and hot air dries the dishes, leaving them soft and fluffy. The drying process also seemed to minimize internal steam and odor, so even on plastic dishes, there were virtually no water droplets. Another advantage I noticed during actual use was its relatively quiet operation. It wasn't too noisy, so it didn't bother me while doing other tasks or having conversations in the kitchen. I was worried that it would be noisy, considering it's a compact dishwasher, but it was relatively quiet, which was satisfying. The ease of use was also excellent. It offers a variety of wash cycles, allowing you to choose based on the level of dirt and type of dishware. Sometimes, I simply run the quick cycle, while others, especially those with heavy oil stains, can be run on the standard cycle. The generous detergent and rinse aid dispensers make it easy to add all-in-one detergents. The included cutlery holder and wine glass holder add practicality to the internal layout. Of course, it's not a perfect product. Installation can be tricky depending on the length and location of the drain hose. If the hose is too far from the sink, you may need to extend it. Depending on your kitchen layout, you may need to carefully check the installation location beforehand. While the six-person capacity is a plus, it may be a bit small for a large family, so consider this before purchasing. Nevertheless, I'm very satisfied with this product as an efficient kitchen helper that significantly reduces the stress of daily dishwashing. I highly recommend it, especially for kitchens with limited space, as it offers thorough cleaning, hygienic sterilization and drying, and easy installation.

Sentence (English): Its practical size allows it to accommodate a variety of dishes, cups, pots, wine glasses, and more for six people without taking up much space, making it ideal for families.
Comments (English): Washing dishes at home has become a burden, so I was looking for a compact dishwasher and chose the Samsung BESPOKE 6-seater countertop dishwasher. Unlike typical built-in models, this one simply sits on top of the sink, making it easy to install and maximizing space. Simply connect the water supply and drain hoses, eliminating the need for any additional installation work, making it perfect for tight spaces like apartment kitchens, studio apartments, and newlywed homes. The design is also a good fit. True to Samsung's BESPOKE line, its simple, modern exterior blends seamlessly with any interior. The clean white and beige tones create a refreshing kitchen feel. Its practical size allows it to accommodate a variety of dishes, cups, pots, wine glasses, and more for six people without taking up much space, making it ideal for families. The dishwashing performance exceeded my expectations. Thanks to the dual 3D water jet system, which sprays water simultaneously from the top and bottom, I felt like the water stream evenly touched all my dishes, including plates and cups. The high-temperature, direct-rinsing action also removed grease relatively cleanly. I especially liked the fact that running it immediately after a meal significantly improved the dishwashing efficiency, as it removed grease before it hardened. The sterilization and drying functions were also impressive. The description stated that the high-temperature sterilization function virtually eliminates harmful bacteria, which gave me peace of mind. I also particularly appreciated the fact that the door automatically opens after the wash is finished and hot air dries the dishes, leaving them soft and fluffy. The drying process also seemed to minimize internal steam and odor, so even on plastic dishes, there were virtually no water droplets. Another advantage I noticed during actual use was its relatively quiet operation. It wasn't too noisy, so it didn't bother me while doing other tasks or having conversations in the kitchen. I was worried that it would be noisy, considering it's a compact dishwasher, but it was relatively quiet, which was satisfying. The ease of use was also excellent. It offers a variety of wash cycles, allowing you to choose based on the level of dirt and type of dishware. Sometimes, I simply run the quick cycle, while others, especially those with heavy oil stains, can be run on the standard cycle. The generous detergent and rinse aid dispensers make it easy to add all-in-one detergents. The included cutlery holder and wine glass holder add practicality to the internal layout. Of course, it's not a perfect product. Installation can be tricky depending on the length and location of the drain hose. If the hose is too far from the sink, you may need to extend it. Depending on your kitchen layout, you may need to carefully check the installation location beforehand. While the six-person capacity is a plus, it may be a bit small for a large family, so consider this before purchasing. Nevertheless, I'm very satisfied with this product as an efficient kitchen helper that significantly reduces the stress of daily dishwashing. I highly recommend it, especially for kitchens with limited space, as it offers thorough cleaning, hygienic sterilization and drying, and easy installation.

Comments (English): Washing dishes at home has become a burden, so I was looking for a compact dishwasher and chose the Samsung BESPOKE 6-seater countertop dishwasher. Unlike typical built-in models, this one simply sits on top of the sink, making it easy to install and maximizing space. Simply connect the water supply and drain hoses, eliminating the need for any additional installation work, making it perfect for tight spaces like apartment kitchens, studio apartments, and newlywed homes. The design is also a good fit. True to Samsung's BESPOKE line, its simple, modern exterior blends seamlessly with any interior. The clean white and beige tones create a refreshing kitchen feel. Its practical size allows it to accommodate a variety of dishes, cups, pots, wine glasses, and more for six people without taking up much space, making it ideal for families. The dishwashing performance exceeded my expectations. Thanks to the dual 3D water jet system, which sprays water simultaneously from the top and bottom, I felt like the water stream evenly touched all my dishes, including plates and cups. The high-temperature, direct-rinsing action also removed grease relatively cleanly. I especially liked the fact that running it immediately after a meal significantly improved the dishwashing efficiency, as it removed grease before it hardened. The sterilization and drying functions were also impressive. The description stated that the high-temperature sterilization function virtually eliminates harmful bacteria, which gave me peace of mind. I also particularly appreciated the fact that the door automatically opens after the wash is finished and hot air dries the dishes, leaving them soft and fluffy. The drying process also seemed to minimize internal steam and odor, so even on plastic dishes, there were virtually no water droplets. Another advantage I noticed during actual use was its relatively quiet operation. It wasn't too noisy, so it didn't bother me while doing other tasks or having conversations in the kitchen. I was worried that it would be noisy, considering it's a compact dishwasher, but it was relatively quiet, which was satisfying. The ease of use was also excellent. It offers a variety of wash cycles, allowing you to choose based on the level of dirt and type of dishware. Sometimes, I simply run the quick cycle, while others, especially those with heavy oil stains, can be run on the standard cycle. The generous detergent and rinse aid dispensers make it easy to add all-in-one detergents. The included cutlery holder and wine glass holder add practicality to the internal layout. Of course, it's not a perfect product. Installation can be tricky depending on the length and location of the drain hose. If the hose is too far from the sink, you may need to extend it. While the six-person capacity is a plus, it may be a bit small for a large family, so consider this before purchasing. Nevertheless, I'm very satisfied with this product as an efficient kitchen helper that significantly reduces the stress of daily dishwashing. I highly recommend it, especially for kitchens with limited space, as it offers thorough cleaning, hygienic sterilization and drying, and easy installation.

Comments (English): Washing dishes at home has become a burden, so I was looking for a compact dishwasher and chose the Samsung BESPOKE 6-seater countertop dishwasher. Simply connect the water supply and drain hoses, eliminating the need for any additional installation work, making it perfect for tight spaces like apartment kitchens, studio apartments, and newlywed homes. The design is also a good fit. True to Samsung's BESPOKE line, its simple, modern exterior blends seamlessly with any interior. The clean white and beige tones create a refreshing kitchen feel. Its practical size allows it to accommodate a variety of dishes, cups, pots, wine glasses, and more for six people without taking up much space, making it ideal for families. The dishwashing performance exceeded my expectations. I especially liked the fact that running it immediately after a meal significantly improved the dishwashing efficiency, as it removed grease before it hardened. The sterilization and drying functions were also impressive. Comments (English): Washing dishes at home has become a burden, so I was looking for a compact dishwasher and chose the Samsung BESPOKE 6-seater countertop dishwasher. The design is also a good fit. True to Samsung's BESPOKE line, its simple, modern exterior blends seamlessly with any interior. The clean white and beige tones create a refreshing kitchen feel. Its practical size allows it to accommodate a variety of dishes, cups, pots, wine glasses, and more for six people without taking up much space, making it ideal for families. The dishwashing performance exceeded my expectations. I especially liked the fact that running it immediately after a meal significantly improved the dishwashing efficiency, as it removed grease before it hardened. I also particularly appreciated the fact that the door automatically opens after the wash is finished and hot air dries the dishes, leaving them soft and fluffy. Sentence (English): It wasn't too noisy, so it didn't bother me while doing other tasks or having conversations in the kitchen.
Comments (English): Washing dishes at home has become a burden, so I was looking for a compact dishwasher and chose the Samsung BESPOKE 6-seater countertop dishwasher. Unlike typical built-in models, this one simply sits on top of the sink, making it easy to install and maximizing space. Simply connect the water supply and drain hoses, eliminating the need for any additional installation work, making it perfect for tight spaces like apartment kitchens, studio apartments, and newlywed homes. The design is also a good fit. True to Samsung's BESPOKE line, its simple, modern exterior blends seamlessly with any interior. The clean white and beige tones create a refreshing kitchen feel. Its practical size allows it to accommodate a variety of dishes, cups, pots, wine glasses, and more for six people without taking up much space, making it ideal for families. The dishwashing performance exceeded my expectations. Thanks to the dual 3D water jet system, which sprays water simultaneously from the top and bottom, I felt like the water stream evenly touched all my dishes, including plates and cups. The high-temperature, direct-rinsing action also removed grease relatively cleanly. I especially liked the fact that running it immediately after a meal significantly improved the dishwashing efficiency, as it removed grease before it hardened. The sterilization and drying functions were also impressive. The description stated that the high-temperature sterilization function virtually eliminates harmful bacteria, which gave me peace of mind. I also particularly appreciated the fact that the door automatically opens after the wash is finished and hot air dries the dishes, leaving them soft and fluffy. The drying process also seemed to minimize internal steam and odor, so even on plastic dishes, there were virtually no water droplets. Another advantage I noticed during actual use was its relatively quiet operation. It wasn't too noisy, so it didn't bother me while doing other tasks or having conversations in the kitchen. I was worried that it would be noisy, considering it's a compact dishwasher, but it was relatively quiet, which was satisfying. The ease of use was also excellent. It offers a variety of wash cycles, allowing you to choose based on the level of dirt and type of dishware. Sometimes, I simply run the quick cycle, while others, especially those with heavy oil stains, can be run on the standard cycle. The generous detergent and rinse aid dispensers make it easy to add all-in-one detergents. The included cutlery holder and wine glass holder add practicality to the internal layout. Of course, it's not a perfect product. Installation can be tricky depending on the length and location of the drain hose. If the hose is too far from the sink, you may need to extend it. Depending on your kitchen layout, you may need to carefully check the installation location beforehand. While the six-person capacity is a plus, it may be a bit small for a large family, so consider this before purchasing. Nevertheless, I'm very satisfied with this product as an efficient kitchen helper that significantly reduces the stress of daily dishwashing. I highly recommend it, especially for kitchens with limited space, as it offers thorough cleaning, hygienic sterilization and drying, and easy installation.

Sentence (English): The ease of use was also excellent.
Comments (English): Washing dishes at home has become a burden, so I was looking for a compact dishwasher and chose the Samsung BESPOKE 6-seater countertop dishwasher. Unlike typical built-in models, this one simply sits on top of the sink, making it easy to install and maximizing space. Simply connect the water supply and drain hoses, eliminating the need for any additional installation work, making it perfect for tight spaces like apartment kitchens, studio apartments, and newlywed homes. The design is also a good fit. True to Samsung's BESPOKE line, its simple, modern exterior blends seamlessly with any interior. The clean white and beige tones create a refreshing kitchen feel. Its practical size allows it to accommodate a variety of dishes, cups, pots, wine glasses, and more for six people without taking up much space, making it ideal for families. The dishwashing performance exceeded my expectations. Thanks to the dual 3D water jet system, which sprays water simultaneously from the top and bottom, I felt like the water stream evenly touched all my dishes, including plates and cups. The high-temperature, direct-rinsing action also removed grease relatively cleanly. I especially liked the fact that running it immediately after a meal significantly improved the dishwashing efficiency, as it removed grease before it hardened. The sterilization and drying functions were also impressive. The description stated that the high-temperature sterilization function virtually eliminates harmful bacteria, which gave me peace of mind. I also particularly appreciated the fact that the door automatically opens after the wash is finished and hot air dries the dishes, leaving them soft and fluffy. The drying process also seemed to minimize internal steam and odor, so even on plastic dishes, there were virtually no water droplets. Another advantage I noticed during actual use was its relatively quiet operation. It wasn't too noisy, so it didn't bother me while doing other tasks or having conversations in the kitchen. I was worried that it would be noisy, considering it's a compact dishwasher, but it was relatively quiet, which was satisfying. The ease of use was also excellent. It offers a variety of wash cycles, allowing you to choose based on the level of dirt and type of dishware. Sometimes, I simply run the quick cycle, while others, especially those with heavy oil stains, can be run on the standard cycle. The generous detergent and rinse aid dispensers make it easy to add all-in-one detergents. The included cutlery holder and wine glass holder add practicality to the internal layout. Of course, it's not a perfect product. Installation can be tricky depending on the length and location of the drain hose. If the hose is too far from the sink, you may need to extend it. Depending on your kitchen layout, you may need to carefully check the installation location beforehand. While the six-person capacity is a plus, it may be a bit small for a large family, so consider this before purchasing. Nevertheless, I'm very satisfied with this product as an efficient kitchen helper that significantly reduces the stress of daily dishwashing. I highly recommend it, especially for kitchens with limited space, as it offers thorough cleaning, hygienic sterilization and drying, and easy installation.

Comments (English): Washing dishes at home has become a burden, so I was looking for a compact dishwasher and chose the Samsung BESPOKE 6-seater countertop dishwasher. Unlike typical built-in models, this one simply sits on top of the sink, making it easy to install and maximizing space. Simply connect the water supply and drain hoses, eliminating the need for any additional installation work, making it perfect for tight spaces like apartment kitchens, studio apartments, and newlywed homes. The design is also a good fit. True to Samsung's BESPOKE line, its simple, modern exterior blends seamlessly with any interior. The clean white and beige tones create a refreshing kitchen feel. Its practical size allows it to accommodate a variety of dishes, cups, pots, wine glasses, and more for six people without taking up much space, making it ideal for families. The dishwashing performance exceeded my expectations. Thanks to the dual 3D water jet system, which sprays water simultaneously from the top and bottom, I felt like the water stream evenly touched all my dishes, including plates and cups. The high-temperature, direct-rinsing action also removed grease relatively cleanly. I especially liked the fact that running it immediately after a meal significantly improved the dishwashing efficiency, as it removed grease before it hardened. The sterilization and drying functions were also impressive. The description stated that the high-temperature sterilization function virtually eliminates harmful bacteria, which gave me peace of mind. I also particularly appreciated the fact that the door automatically opens after the wash is finished and hot air dries the dishes, leaving them soft and fluffy. The drying process also seemed to minimize internal steam and odor, so even on plastic dishes, there were virtually no water droplets. Another advantage I noticed during actual use was its relatively quiet operation. It wasn't too noisy, so it didn't bother me while doing other tasks or having conversations in the kitchen. I was worried that it would be noisy, considering it's a compact dishwasher, but it was relatively quiet, which was satisfying. The ease of use was also excellent. It offers a variety of wash cycles, allowing you to choose based on the level of dirt and type of dishware. Sometimes, I simply run the quick cycle, while others, especially those with heavy oil stains, can be run on the standard cycle. The generous detergent and rinse aid dispensers make it easy to add all-in-one detergents. The included cutlery holder and wine glass holder add practicality to the internal layout. Of course, it's not a perfect product. Installation can be tricky depending on the length and location of the drain hose. If the hose is too far from the sink, you may need to extend it. Depending on your kitchen layout, you may need to carefully check the installation location beforehand. While the six-person capacity is a plus, it may be a bit small for a large family, so consider this before purchasing. Nevertheless, I'm very satisfied with this product as an efficient kitchen helper that significantly reduces the stress of daily dishwashing. I highly recommend it, especially for kitchens with limited space, as it offers thorough cleaning, hygienic sterilization and drying, and easy installation.

Comments (English): Washing dishes at home has become a burden, so I was looking for a compact dishwasher and chose the Samsung BESPOKE 6-seater countertop dishwasher. Unlike typical built-in models, this one simply sits on top of the sink, making it easy to install and maximizing space. Simply connect the water supply and drain hoses, eliminating the need for any additional installation work, making it perfect for tight spaces like apartment kitchens, studio apartments, and newlywed homes. The design is also a good fit. True to Samsung's BESPOKE line, its simple, modern exterior blends seamlessly with any interior. The clean white and beige tones create a refreshing kitchen feel. Its practical size allows it to accommodate a variety of dishes, cups, pots, wine glasses, and more for six people without taking up much space, making it ideal for families. The dishwashing performance exceeded my expectations. Thanks to the dual 3D water jet system, which sprays water simultaneously from the top and bottom, I felt like the water stream evenly touched all my dishes, including plates and cups. The high-temperature, direct-rinsing action also removed grease relatively cleanly. I especially liked the fact that running it immediately after a meal significantly improved the dishwashing efficiency, as it removed grease before it hardened. The sterilization and drying functions were also impressive. The description stated that the high-temperature sterilization function virtually eliminates harmful bacteria, which gave me peace of mind. I also particularly appreciated the fact that the door automatically opens after the wash is finished and hot air dries the dishes, leaving them soft and fluffy. The drying process also seemed to minimize internal steam and odor, so even on plastic dishes, there were virtually no water droplets. I was worried that it would be noisy, considering it's a compact dishwasher, but it was relatively quiet, which was satisfying. The ease of use was also excellent. It offers a variety of wash cycles, allowing you to choose based on the level of dirt and type of dishware. Sometimes, I simply run the quick cycle, while others, especially those with heavy oil stains, can be run on the standard cycle. Nevertheless, I'm very satisfied with this product as an efficient kitchen helper that significantly reduces the stress of daily dishwashing. I highly recommend it, especially for kitchens with limited space, as it offers thorough cleaning, hygienic sterilization and drying, and easy installation.

Comments (English): Washing dishes at home has become a burden, so I was looking for a compact dishwasher and chose the Samsung BESPOKE 6-seater countertop dishwasher. Unlike typical built-in models, this one simply sits on top of the sink, making it easy to install and maximizing space. Simply connect the water supply and drain hoses, eliminating the need for any additional installation work, making it perfect for tight spaces like apartment kitchens, studio apartments, and newlywed homes. The design is also a good fit. True to Samsung's BESPOKE line, its simple, modern exterior blends seamlessly with any interior. The clean white and beige tones create a refreshing kitchen feel. Its practical size allows it to accommodate a variety of dishes, cups, pots, wine glasses, and more for six people without taking up much space, making it ideal for families. The dishwashing performance exceeded my expectations. Thanks to the dual 3D water jet system, which sprays water simultaneously from the top and bottom, I felt like the water stream evenly touched all my dishes, including plates and cups. The high-temperature, direct-rinsing action also removed grease relatively cleanly. I especially liked the fact that running it immediately after a meal significantly improved the dishwashing efficiency, as it removed grease before it hardened. The sterilization and drying functions were also impressive. The description stated that the high-temperature sterilization function virtually eliminates harmful bacteria, which gave me peace of mind. I also particularly appreciated the fact that the door automatically opens after the wash is finished and hot air dries the dishes, leaving them soft and fluffy. The drying process also seemed to minimize internal steam and odor, so even on plastic dishes, there were virtually no water droplets. Another advantage I noticed during actual use was its relatively quiet operation. It wasn't too noisy, so it didn't bother me while doing other tasks or having conversations in the kitchen. I was worried that it would be noisy, considering it's a compact dishwasher, but it was relatively quiet, which was satisfying. The ease of use was also excellent. It offers a variety of wash cycles, allowing you to choose based on the level of dirt and type of dishware. Sometimes, I simply run the quick cycle, while others, especially those with heavy oil stains, can be run on the standard cycle. The generous detergent and rinse aid dispensers make it easy to add all-in-one detergents. The included cutlery holder and wine glass holder add practicality to the internal layout. Of course, it's not a perfect product. Installation can be tricky depending on the length and location of the drain hose. If the hose is too far from the sink, you may need to extend it. While the six-person capacity is a plus, it may be a bit small for a large family, so consider this before purchasing. Nevertheless, I'm very satisfied with this product as an efficient kitchen helper that significantly reduces the stress of daily dishwashing. I highly recommend it, especially for kitchens with limited space, as it offers thorough cleaning, hygienic sterilization and drying, and easy installation.

Comments (English): Washing dishes at home has become a burden, so I was looking for a compact dishwasher and chose the Samsung BESPOKE 6-seater countertop dishwasher. Unlike typical built-in models, this one simply sits on top of the sink, making it easy to install and maximizing space. Simply connect the water supply and drain hoses, eliminating the need for any additional installation work, making it perfect for tight spaces like apartment kitchens, studio apartments, and newlywed homes. The design is also a good fit. True to Samsung's BESPOKE line, its simple, modern exterior blends seamlessly with any interior. The clean white and beige tones create a refreshing kitchen feel. Its practical size allows it to accommodate a variety of dishes, cups, pots, wine glasses, and more for six people without taking up much space, making it ideal for families. The dishwashing performance exceeded my expectations. Thanks to the dual 3D water jet system, which sprays water simultaneously from the top and bottom, I felt like the water stream evenly touched all my dishes, including plates and cups. The high-temperature, direct-rinsing action also removed grease relatively cleanly. I especially liked the fact that running it immediately after a meal significantly improved the dishwashing efficiency, as it removed grease before it hardened. The sterilization and drying functions were also impressive. The description stated that the high-temperature sterilization function virtually eliminates harmful bacteria, which gave me peace of mind. I also particularly appreciated the fact that the door automatically opens after the wash is finished and hot air dries the dishes, leaving them soft and fluffy. The drying process also seemed to minimize internal steam and odor, so even on plastic dishes, there were virtually no water droplets. Another advantage I noticed during actual use was its relatively quiet operation. It wasn't too noisy, so it didn't bother me while doing other tasks or having conversations in the kitchen. I was worried that it would be noisy, considering it's a compact dishwasher, but it was relatively quiet, which was satisfying. The ease of use was also excellent. It offers a variety of wash cycles, allowing you to choose based on the level of dirt and type of dishware. Sometimes, I simply run the quick cycle, while others, especially those with heavy oil stains, can be run on the standard cycle. The generous detergent and rinse aid dispensers make it easy to add all-in-one detergents. The included cutlery holder and wine glass holder add practicality to the internal layout. Of course, it's not a perfect product. Installation can be tricky depending on the length and location of the drain hose. If the hose is too far from the sink, you may need to extend it. Depending on your kitchen layout, you may need to carefully check the installation location beforehand. While the six-person capacity is a plus, it may be a bit small for a large family, so consider this before purchasing. Nevertheless, I'm very satisfied with this product as an efficient kitchen helper that significantly reduces the stress of daily dishwashing. I highly recommend it, especially for kitchens with limited space, as it offers thorough cleaning, hygienic sterilization and drying, and easy installation.

Sentence (English): The dishwasher is overall very quiet which we are happy with.
Comments (English): [ Overall satisfied but see room for improvement ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher is overall very quiet which we are happy with. We did have a bit of a hose connector leak, which my husband was able to fix, but it did do some light damage to our wood flooring. I'm disappointed that a normal wash cycle takes 3 hours to clean, our prior machine was 2 hours. The layout while is very much like many other dishwashers does not fit oversized bowls well and we find plates can easily collapse on one another which I imagine may decrease cleaning effectiveness. So far though dishes have come out nice and clean. The roll out braces for the dish trays move quite a bit giving them the feel of being cheapy made vs solid. Which leaves me to worry if over time they will break easily. I do like the adjustable element of them so if needed you can adjust it up or downward as needed. I would like to see more of a tilted angle at least on one of the cup areas for mugs and or glasses that have concave bottoms, which tend to hold water even after a cycle is done. One the bottom tray, I don't understand why such a wide gap is left between the last peg and outside of the tray. I suspect it is intended for a larger than normal dish but would recommend that if that was the intention, make that last peg collapsible vs always gone as it is rare to need that space and anything you put there is left loose vs fitted. Capacity seems to be the standard amount.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher performs incredibly!
Comments (English): [ This dishwasher is like magic! ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher performs incredibly! The three racks are so spacious and multi-functional--I have no idea how so much stuff can fit into the dishwasher and come out perfectly clean and sanitized. I use a fraction of the water I used to (I'm in CA -- always need to be drought aware! ), and the amount of time I spend washing dishes has been cut down incredibly.I've never put items other than plates, bowls, cups and silverware in a dishwasher. I now load up every dish that is dishwasher safe, leaving me with a fraction of hand wash dishes. I even put in a 9x13 casserole dish that had completely dried eggs stuck to it from the previous day. I love how when the cycle is finished, the door opens by itself to let the steam out. This helps get all the last drops out before you empty it. The noise is minimal when it's running.The only con is that you have to buy the hose and cord separately. This seems crazy to me that these are not included. Also, there is no manual included -- you have to search for it online, though this seems to be more common these days.

Sentence (English): I was looking for a very low cost dishwasher, and this met that goal.
Comments (English): [ Low price for low end model ] || ---------------- || I was looking for a very low cost dishwasher, and this met that goal. There are tradeoffs for low cost. The bottom rack is almost impossible to keep on its track. The utensil rack has no way to keep things from nesting into each other. There is no sound-deadening material around the tub so it runs loud. Installation instructions are adequate but the user instructions are poor, giving almost no help and being printed on a large sheet of thin newsprint. Maybe they thought you wouldn't need instructions since this model has almost no features. Bottom line is that this model is priced appropriately but feels cheap. Most people will want to move up at least one or two steps in quality and features.

Overall we are LOVING it. : )

Sentence (English): I debated this for 3-4 months, but I should have done it sooner.
Comments (English): [ I am super, super, super satisfied—so much so that the time I spent hesitating was a waste! ] || ---------------- || I debated this for 3-4 months, but I should have done it sooner. I am so satisfied! My main concerns were two things: 1. That it doesn't dry well? Just in case, I added extra drying mode the first time and ran only the top section, and there was no water. The next day, I ran it on the standard top and bottom cycle without adding extra drying. After a while, I checked and found that there was water on the bottom but none on the top! 2. Would it install in an old apartment? My apartment is old, so there isn't even a separate shut-off valve for the sink water. The technician came and installed it perfectly! ***. Advantages of the My Dear Dishwasher: 1. You can run the top and bottom sections separately. It feels wasteful to run the dishwasher when there are only a few dishes. However, you can set it to run only the top or bottom section. So, I liked that I could run it without worry even when the amount of dishes was small. 2. There is a multi-purpose basket on top. I keep my spoons and chopsticks in the multi-purpose basket on top. Although there is a cutlery holder, I feel like keeping them separate helps them clean better. I'm using it in the multi-purpose basket! 3. It's wider and bigger than I expected. The dishwasher at work is an 8-place setting, and the one at my grandmother's is a 12-place setting, but there wasn't as big a difference as I thought. So I assumed the My Dear dishwasher would be the same. But wow. The interior space is spacious, and the bottom is tall, so pots slide right in. I can actually use quite a lot of space. Especially when you eat a meal, you need spoons, plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and pots—you know, that's a lot. I thought I could just use the top or bottom sections! + The sink area looks much cleaner. Since there is no drying rack, the cooking space at the sink has expanded, which I love so much! Rocket Installation, Rocket Delivery. I seriously got a +10,000,000 rating for Rocket Installation. Since it's an old apartment, the faucets were worn out, and I wanted to have a pantry installed along with it, so I had prepared a pantry. I had planned to install the dishwasher first and then insert the pantry once the technician left. I am so satisfied! My main concerns were two things: 1. That it doesn't dry well? Just in case, I added extra drying mode the first time and ran only the top section, and there was no water. The next day, I ran it on the standard top and bottom cycle without adding extra drying. After a while, I checked and found that there was water on the bottom but none on the top! 2. Would it install in an old apartment? My apartment is old, so there isn't even a separate shut-off valve for the sink water. The technician came and installed it perfectly! ***. Advantages of the My Dear Dishwasher: 1. You can run the top and bottom sections separately. It feels wasteful to run the dishwasher when there are only a few dishes. However, you can set it to run only the top or bottom section. So, I liked that I could run it without worry even when the amount of dishes was small. 2. There is a multi-purpose basket on top. I keep my spoons and chopsticks in the multi-purpose basket on top. Although there is a cutlery holder, I feel like keeping them separate helps them clean better. I'm using it in the multi-purpose basket! 3. It's wider and bigger than I expected. The dishwasher at work is an 8-place setting, and the one at my grandmother's is a 12-place setting, but there wasn't as big a difference as I thought. So I assumed the My Dear dishwasher would be the same. But wow. The interior space is spacious, and the bottom is tall, so pots slide right in. I can actually use quite a lot of space. Especially when you eat a meal, you need spoons, plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and pots—you know, that's a lot. I thought I could just use the top or bottom sections! + The sink area looks much cleaner. Since there is no drying rack, the cooking space at the sink has expanded, which I love so much! Rocket Installation, Rocket Delivery. I seriously got a +10,000,000 rating for Rocket Installation. Since it's an old apartment, the faucets were worn out, and I wanted to have a pantry installed along with it, so I had prepared a pantry. I had planned to install the dishwasher first and then insert the pantry once the technician left. However, the technician readily agreed that it would be better to watch the installation process together. The technician personally helped install the pantry. He also checked to see if the drain pipes or other wires were interfering with it. He tested everything and left. Right after he left, I ran the dishwasher and took a nap. When I woke up, the living room was flooded. Shocked, I called the technician to let him know, and he came right away! He said that after checking, the sink faucet seemed to be the primary cause, and that if the water continued to leak even after fixing the faucet, it would likely be a problem with the dishwasher. (Honestly, if the sink faucet were the primary cause, he could have just told me to call someone else to fix it first.) However, since it was Sunday and the hardware store probably wouldn't be open, he said he would go to the hardware store on Monday to buy a new faucet, fix the dishwasher, and then check for the secondary cause. He came back to our house the next day at 10 am. After fixing the sink faucet and checking for a mechanical defect, it turned out that wasn't the case. Thanks to him, we now have a dishwasher and can use a new sink faucet. I am so sorry and grateful. I was so touched that you checked everything so thoroughly and took responsibility until the very end. My Dear itself is great, but thanks to the technician, I gained trust in Coupang Rocket Installation. I don't know if you will read this, but thank you so much! Downsides. Actually, there are no downsides yet. I already knew how to use a dishwasher to some extent from looking at the one at my company, even though the brand is different. Also, I don't have the confidence to remove food particles stuck in the dishwasher myself. So, I rinse out solid food scraps and chili powder with water beforehand (and plan to continue doing so). Electricity costs. I think it might be cheaper than my own labor. If any downsides arise, I will come back to write about them. +++++. 26.03.25. Downsides. I think I understand what you mean about it not drying. Since I only eat dinner on weekdays, I use the dishwasher in the evening as well. I run the dishwasher tonight, and then tomorrow evening, I take the dishes out, organize them, and put in the dishes from that day's dinner. However, I discovered a downside over the weekend. Since I eat breakfast, lunch, and dinner with the kids on the weekend, I ran the dishwasher around lunchtime. When I went to clean up in the evening, I found there was still moisture, making it difficult to tidy up immediately. Because we have a dishwasher, we don't use a separate drying rack; we just use the cup holder on the sink. So, it is a bit of a shame that I can't clean up right away. At work, I use an LG dishwasher, and even that wasn't completely dry after it finished. The difference is that the LG dishwasher leaves just a few droplets of water, whereas the My Dear dishwasher leaves water dripping down. The cleaning power is good, so I am satisfied!

However, since it was Sunday and the hardware store probably wouldn't be open, he said he would go to the hardware store on Monday to buy a new faucet, fix the dishwasher, and then check for the secondary cause.
