The dishwasher at work is an 8-place setting, and the one at my grandmother's is a 12-place setting, but there wasn't as big a difference as I thought. So I assumed the My Dear dishwasher would be the same. But wow. The interior space is spacious, and the bottom is tall, so pots slide right in. I can actually use quite a lot of space. Especially when you eat a meal, you need spoons, plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and pots—you know, that's a lot. When I woke up, the living room was flooded. Shocked, I called the technician to let him know, and he came right away! He said that after checking, the sink faucet seemed to be the primary cause, and that if the water continued to leak even after fixing the faucet, it would likely be a problem with the dishwasher. (Honestly, if the sink faucet were the primary cause, he could have just told me to call someone else to fix it first.) However, since it was Sunday and the hardware store probably wouldn't be open, he said he would go to the hardware store on Monday to buy a new faucet, fix the dishwasher, and then check for the secondary cause. He came back to our house the next day at 10 am. After fixing the sink faucet and checking for a mechanical defect, it turned out that wasn't the case. Thanks to him, we now have a dishwasher and can use a new sink faucet. I am so sorry and grateful. I was so touched that you checked everything so thoroughly and took responsibility until the very end. My Dear itself is great, but thanks to the technician, I gained trust in Coupang Rocket Installation. I don't know if you will read this, but thank you so much! Downsides. Actually, there are no downsides yet. I already knew how to use a dishwasher to some extent from looking at the one at my company, even though the brand is different. Also, I don't have the confidence to remove food particles stuck in the dishwasher myself. So, I rinse out solid food scraps and chili powder with water beforehand (and plan to continue doing so). Electricity costs. I think it might be cheaper than my own labor. If any downsides arise, I will come back to write about them. +++++. 26.03.25. Downsides. I think I understand what you mean about it not drying. Since I only eat dinner on weekdays, I use the dishwasher in the evening as well. I run the dishwasher tonight, and then tomorrow evening, I take the dishes out, organize them, and put in the dishes from that day's dinner. However, I discovered a downside over the weekend. The difference is that the LG dishwasher leaves just a few droplets of water, whereas the My Dear dishwasher leaves water dripping down. The cleaning power is good, so I am satisfied!

Comments (English): [ I am super, super, super satisfied—so much so that the time I spent hesitating was a waste! ] || ---------------- || I debated this for 3-4 months, but I should have done it sooner. I am so satisfied! My main concerns were two things: 1. That it doesn't dry well? Just in case, I added extra drying mode the first time and ran only the top section, and there was no water. The next day, I ran it on the standard top and bottom cycle without adding extra drying. After a while, I checked and found that there was water on the bottom but none on the top! 2. Would it install in an old apartment? My apartment is old, so there isn't even a separate shut-off valve for the sink water. The technician came and installed it perfectly! ***. Advantages of the My Dear Dishwasher: 1. You can run the top and bottom sections separately. It feels wasteful to run the dishwasher when there are only a few dishes. However, you can set it to run only the top or bottom section. So, I liked that I could run it without worry even when the amount of dishes was small. 2. There is a multi-purpose basket on top. I keep my spoons and chopsticks in the multi-purpose basket on top. Although there is a cutlery holder, I feel like keeping them separate helps them clean better. I'm using it in the multi-purpose basket! 3. It's wider and bigger than I expected. The dishwasher at work is an 8-place setting, and the one at my grandmother's is a 12-place setting, but there wasn't as big a difference as I thought. So I assumed the My Dear dishwasher would be the same. But wow. The interior space is spacious, and the bottom is tall, so pots slide right in. I can actually use quite a lot of space. Especially when you eat a meal, you need spoons, plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and pots—you know, that's a lot. I thought I could just use the top or bottom sections! + The sink area looks much cleaner. Since there is no drying rack, the cooking space at the sink has expanded, which I love so much! Rocket Installation, Rocket Delivery. I seriously got a +10,000,000 rating for Rocket Installation. Since it's an old apartment, the faucets were worn out, and I wanted to have a pantry installed along with it, so I had prepared a pantry. I had planned to install the dishwasher first and then insert the pantry once the technician left. However, the technician readily agreed that it would be better to watch the installation process together. The technician personally helped install the pantry. He also checked to see if the drain pipes or other wires were interfering with it. He tested everything and left. Right after he left, I ran the dishwasher and took a nap. When I woke up, the living room was flooded. Shocked, I called the technician to let him know, and he came right away! He said that after checking, the sink faucet seemed to be the primary cause, and that if the water continued to leak even after fixing the faucet, it would likely be a problem with the dishwasher. (Honestly, if the sink faucet were the primary cause, he could have just told me to call someone else to fix it first.) However, since it was Sunday and the hardware store probably wouldn't be open, he said he would go to the hardware store on Monday to buy a new faucet, fix the dishwasher, and then check for the secondary cause. He came back to our house the next day at 10 am. After fixing the sink faucet and checking for a mechanical defect, it turned out that wasn't the case. Thanks to him, we now have a dishwasher and can use a new sink faucet. I am so sorry and grateful. I was so touched that you checked everything so thoroughly and took responsibility until the very end. My Dear itself is great, but thanks to the technician, I gained trust in Coupang Rocket Installation. I don't know if you will read this, but thank you so much! Downsides. Actually, there are no downsides yet. I already knew how to use a dishwasher to some extent from looking at the one at my company, even though the brand is different. Also, I don't have the confidence to remove food particles stuck in the dishwasher myself. So, I rinse out solid food scraps and chili powder with water beforehand (and plan to continue doing so). Electricity costs. I think it might be cheaper than my own labor. If any downsides arise, I will come back to write about them. +++++. 26.03.25. Downsides. I think I understand what you mean about it not drying. Since I only eat dinner on weekdays, I use the dishwasher in the evening as well. I run the dishwasher tonight, and then tomorrow evening, I take the dishes out, organize them, and put in the dishes from that day's dinner. However, I discovered a downside over the weekend. Since I eat breakfast, lunch, and dinner with the kids on the weekend, I ran the dishwasher around lunchtime. When I went to clean up in the evening, I found there was still moisture, making it difficult to tidy up immediately. Because we have a dishwasher, we don't use a separate drying rack; we just use the cup holder on the sink. So, it is a bit of a shame that I can't clean up right away. At work, I use an LG dishwasher, and even that wasn't completely dry after it finished. The difference is that the LG dishwasher leaves just a few droplets of water, whereas the My Dear dishwasher leaves water dripping down. The cleaning power is good, so I am satisfied!

I keep my spoons and chopsticks in the multi-purpose basket on top. Although there is a cutlery holder, I feel like keeping them separate helps them clean better. I'm using it in the multi-purpose basket! 3. It's wider and bigger than I expected. I had planned to install the dishwasher first and then insert the pantry once the technician left. He also checked to see if the drain pipes or other wires were interfering with it. He tested everything and left. Right after he left, I ran the dishwasher and took a nap. When I woke up, the living room was flooded. Shocked, I called the technician to let him know, and he came right away! He said that after checking, the sink faucet seemed to be the primary cause, and that if the water continued to leak even after fixing the faucet, it would likely be a problem with the dishwasher. (Honestly, if the sink faucet were the primary cause, he could have just told me to call someone else to fix it first.) However, since it was Sunday and the hardware store probably wouldn't be open, he said he would go to the hardware store on Monday to buy a new faucet, fix the dishwasher, and then check for the secondary cause. He came back to our house the next day at 10 am. After fixing the sink faucet and checking for a mechanical defect, it turned out that wasn't the case. Thanks to him, we now have a dishwasher and can use a new sink faucet. I am so sorry and grateful. I was so touched that you checked everything so thoroughly and took responsibility until the very end. My Dear itself is great, but thanks to the technician, I gained trust in Coupang Rocket Installation. I don't know if you will read this, but thank you so much! Downsides. Actually, there are no downsides yet. I already knew how to use a dishwasher to some extent from looking at the one at my company, even though the brand is different. Also, I don't have the confidence to remove food particles stuck in the dishwasher myself. So, I rinse out solid food scraps and chili powder with water beforehand (and plan to continue doing so). Comments (English): [ I am super, super, super satisfied—so much so that the time I spent hesitating was a waste! ] || ---------------- || I debated this for 3-4 months, but I should have done it sooner. I am so satisfied! My main concerns were two things: 1. That it doesn't dry well? Just in case, I added extra drying mode the first time and ran only the top section, and there was no water. The next day, I ran it on the standard top and bottom cycle without adding extra drying. After a while, I checked and found that there was water on the bottom but none on the top! 2. Would it install in an old apartment? My apartment is old, so there isn't even a separate shut-off valve for the sink water. The technician came and installed it perfectly! ***. Advantages of the My Dear Dishwasher: 1. You can run the top and bottom sections separately. It feels wasteful to run the dishwasher when there are only a few dishes. However, you can set it to run only the top or bottom section. So, I liked that I could run it without worry even when the amount of dishes was small. 2. There is a multi-purpose basket on top. I keep my spoons and chopsticks in the multi-purpose basket on top. Although there is a cutlery holder, I feel like keeping them separate helps them clean better. I'm using it in the multi-purpose basket! 3. It's wider and bigger than I expected. The dishwasher at work is an 8-place setting, and the one at my grandmother's is a 12-place setting, but there wasn't as big a difference as I thought. So I assumed the My Dear dishwasher would be the same. But wow. The interior space is spacious, and the bottom is tall, so pots slide right in. I can actually use quite a lot of space. Especially when you eat a meal, you need spoons, plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and pots—you know, that's a lot. I thought I could just use the top or bottom sections! + The sink area looks much cleaner. Since there is no drying rack, the cooking space at the sink has expanded, which I love so much! Rocket Installation, Rocket Delivery. I seriously got a +10,000,000 rating for Rocket Installation. Since it's an old apartment, the faucets were worn out, and I wanted to have a pantry installed along with it, so I had prepared a pantry. I had planned to install the dishwasher first and then insert the pantry once the technician left. However, the technician readily agreed that it would be better to watch the installation process together. The technician personally helped install the pantry. He also checked to see if the drain pipes or other wires were interfering with it. He tested everything and left. Right after he left, I ran the dishwasher and took a nap. When I woke up, the living room was flooded. Shocked, I called the technician to let him know, and he came right away! He said that after checking, the sink faucet seemed to be the primary cause, and that if the water continued to leak even after fixing the faucet, it would likely be a problem with the dishwasher. (Honestly, if the sink faucet were the primary cause, he could have just told me to call someone else to fix it first.) However, since it was Sunday and the hardware store probably wouldn't be open, he said he would go to the hardware store on Monday to buy a new faucet, fix the dishwasher, and then check for the secondary cause. He came back to our house the next day at 10 am. After fixing the sink faucet and checking for a mechanical defect, it turned out that wasn't the case. Thanks to him, we now have a dishwasher and can use a new sink faucet. I am so sorry and grateful. I was so touched that you checked everything so thoroughly and took responsibility until the very end. My Dear itself is great, but thanks to the technician, I gained trust in Coupang Rocket Installation. I don't know if you will read this, but thank you so much! Downsides. Actually, there are no downsides yet. I already knew how to use a dishwasher to some extent from looking at the one at my company, even though the brand is different. Also, I don't have the confidence to remove food particles stuck in the dishwasher myself. So, I rinse out solid food scraps and chili powder with water beforehand (and plan to continue doing so). Electricity costs. I think it might be cheaper than my own labor. If any downsides arise, I will come back to write about them. +++++. 26.03.25. Downsides. I think I understand what you mean about it not drying. Since I only eat dinner on weekdays, I use the dishwasher in the evening as well. I run the dishwasher tonight, and then tomorrow evening, I take the dishes out, organize them, and put in the dishes from that day's dinner. However, I discovered a downside over the weekend. Since I eat breakfast, lunch, and dinner with the kids on the weekend, I ran the dishwasher around lunchtime. When I went to clean up in the evening, I found there was still moisture, making it difficult to tidy up immediately. Because we have a dishwasher, we don't use a separate drying rack; we just use the cup holder on the sink. So, it is a bit of a shame that I can't clean up right away. At work, I use an LG dishwasher, and even that wasn't completely dry after it finished. The difference is that the LG dishwasher leaves just a few droplets of water, whereas the My Dear dishwasher leaves water dripping down. The cleaning power is good, so I am satisfied!

The next day, I ran it on the standard top and bottom cycle without adding extra drying. After a while, I checked and found that there was water on the bottom but none on the top! 2. Would it install in an old apartment? My apartment is old, so there isn't even a separate shut-off valve for the sink water. The technician came and installed it perfectly! ***. Advantages of the My Dear Dishwasher: 1. You can run the top and bottom sections separately. It feels wasteful to run the dishwasher when there are only a few dishes. However, you can set it to run only the top or bottom section. So, I liked that I could run it without worry even when the amount of dishes was small. 2. There is a multi-purpose basket on top. I keep my spoons and chopsticks in the multi-purpose basket on top. Although there is a cutlery holder, I feel like keeping them separate helps them clean better. I'm using it in the multi-purpose basket! 3. It's wider and bigger than I expected. The dishwasher at work is an 8-place setting, and the one at my grandmother's is a 12-place setting, but there wasn't as big a difference as I thought. So I assumed the My Dear dishwasher would be the same. But wow. The interior space is spacious, and the bottom is tall, so pots slide right in. I can actually use quite a lot of space. Especially when you eat a meal, you need spoons, plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and pots—you know, that's a lot. I thought I could just use the top or bottom sections! + The sink area looks much cleaner. Since there is no drying rack, the cooking space at the sink has expanded, which I love so much! Rocket Installation, Rocket Delivery. I seriously got a +10,000,000 rating for Rocket Installation. Since it's an old apartment, the faucets were worn out, and I wanted to have a pantry installed along with it, so I had prepared a pantry. I had planned to install the dishwasher first and then insert the pantry once the technician left. However, the technician readily agreed that it would be better to watch the installation process together. The technician personally helped install the pantry. He also checked to see if the drain pipes or other wires were interfering with it. He tested everything and left. Right after he left, I ran the dishwasher and took a nap. When I woke up, the living room was flooded. Shocked, I called the technician to let him know, and he came right away! He said that after checking, the sink faucet seemed to be the primary cause, and that if the water continued to leak even after fixing the faucet, it would likely be a problem with the dishwasher. (Honestly, if the sink faucet were the primary cause, he could have just told me to call someone else to fix it first.) However, since it was Sunday and the hardware store probably wouldn't be open, he said he would go to the hardware store on Monday to buy a new faucet, fix the dishwasher, and then check for the secondary cause. He came back to our house the next day at 10 am. After fixing the sink faucet and checking for a mechanical defect, it turned out that wasn't the case. Thanks to him, we now have a dishwasher and can use a new sink faucet. I am so sorry and grateful. I was so touched that you checked everything so thoroughly and took responsibility until the very end. My Dear itself is great, but thanks to the technician, I gained trust in Coupang Rocket Installation. I don't know if you will read this, but thank you so much! Downsides. Actually, there are no downsides yet. I already knew how to use a dishwasher to some extent from looking at the one at my company, even though the brand is different. Also, I don't have the confidence to remove food particles stuck in the dishwasher myself. So, I rinse out solid food scraps and chili powder with water beforehand (and plan to continue doing so). Electricity costs. I think it might be cheaper than my own labor. If any downsides arise, I will come back to write about them. +++++. 26.03.25. Downsides. I think I understand what you mean about it not drying. Since I only eat dinner on weekdays, I use the dishwasher in the evening as well. I run the dishwasher tonight, and then tomorrow evening, I take the dishes out, organize them, and put in the dishes from that day's dinner. However, I discovered a downside over the weekend. Since I eat breakfast, lunch, and dinner with the kids on the weekend, I ran the dishwasher around lunchtime. When I went to clean up in the evening, I found there was still moisture, making it difficult to tidy up immediately. Because we have a dishwasher, we don't use a separate drying rack; we just use the cup holder on the sink. So, it is a bit of a shame that I can't clean up right away. At work, I use an LG dishwasher, and even that wasn't completely dry after it finished. The difference is that the LG dishwasher leaves just a few droplets of water, whereas the My Dear dishwasher leaves water dripping down. The cleaning power is good, so I am satisfied!

Advantages of the My Dear Dishwasher: 1. You can run the top and bottom sections separately. It feels wasteful to run the dishwasher when there are only a few dishes. However, you can set it to run only the top or bottom section. So, I liked that I could run it without worry even when the amount of dishes was small. 2. There is a multi-purpose basket on top. I'm using it in the multi-purpose basket! 3. It's wider and bigger than I expected. The dishwasher at work is an 8-place setting, and the one at my grandmother's is a 12-place setting, but there wasn't as big a difference as I thought. So I assumed the My Dear dishwasher would be the same. But wow. The interior space is spacious, and the bottom is tall, so pots slide right in. I can actually use quite a lot of space. Especially when you eat a meal, you need spoons, plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and pots—you know, that's a lot. I thought I could just use the top or bottom sections! + The sink area looks much cleaner. Since there is no drying rack, the cooking space at the sink has expanded, which I love so much! Rocket Installation, Rocket Delivery. I seriously got a +10,000,000 rating for Rocket Installation. Since it's an old apartment, the faucets were worn out, and I wanted to have a pantry installed along with it, so I had prepared a pantry. When I woke up, the living room was flooded. Shocked, I called the technician to let him know, and he came right away! He said that after checking, the sink faucet seemed to be the primary cause, and that if the water continued to leak even after fixing the faucet, it would likely be a problem with the dishwasher. (Honestly, if the sink faucet were the primary cause, he could have just told me to call someone else to fix it first.) However, since it was Sunday and the hardware store probably wouldn't be open, he said he would go to the hardware store on Monday to buy a new faucet, fix the dishwasher, and then check for the secondary cause. He came back to our house the next day at 10 am. After fixing the sink faucet and checking for a mechanical defect, it turned out that wasn't the case. Thanks to him, we now have a dishwasher and can use a new sink faucet. I am so sorry and grateful. I was so touched that you checked everything so thoroughly and took responsibility until the very end. My Dear itself is great, but thanks to the technician, I gained trust in Coupang Rocket Installation. I don't know if you will read this, but thank you so much! Downsides. Actually, there are no downsides yet. I already knew how to use a dishwasher to some extent from looking at the one at my company, even though the brand is different. Also, I don't have the confidence to remove food particles stuck in the dishwasher myself. So, I rinse out solid food scraps and chili powder with water beforehand (and plan to continue doing so). Electricity costs. I think it might be cheaper than my own labor. If any downsides arise, I will come back to write about them. +++++. 26.03.25. Downsides. I think I understand what you mean about it not drying. Since I only eat dinner on weekdays, I use the dishwasher in the evening as well. I run the dishwasher tonight, and then tomorrow evening, I take the dishes out, organize them, and put in the dishes from that day's dinner. However, I discovered a downside over the weekend. Since I eat breakfast, lunch, and dinner with the kids on the weekend, I ran the dishwasher around lunchtime. When I went to clean up in the evening, I found there was still moisture, making it difficult to tidy up immediately. Because we have a dishwasher, we don't use a separate drying rack; we just use the cup holder on the sink. So, it is a bit of a shame that I can't clean up right away. At work, I use an LG dishwasher, and even that wasn't completely dry after it finished. The difference is that the LG dishwasher leaves just a few droplets of water, whereas the My Dear dishwasher leaves water dripping down. The cleaning power is good, so I am satisfied!

I am so satisfied! My main concerns were two things: 1. That it doesn't dry well? Just in case, I added extra drying mode the first time and ran only the top section, and there was no water. The next day, I ran it on the standard top and bottom cycle without adding extra drying. After a while, I checked and found that there was water on the bottom but none on the top! 2. Would it install in an old apartment? My apartment is old, so there isn't even a separate shut-off valve for the sink water. The technician came and installed it perfectly! ***. Advantages of the My Dear Dishwasher: 1. You can run the top and bottom sections separately. It feels wasteful to run the dishwasher when there are only a few dishes. However, you can set it to run only the top or bottom section. So, I liked that I could run it without worry even when the amount of dishes was small. 2. There is a multi-purpose basket on top. I keep my spoons and chopsticks in the multi-purpose basket on top. Although there is a cutlery holder, I feel like keeping them separate helps them clean better. I'm using it in the multi-purpose basket! 3. It's wider and bigger than I expected. The dishwasher at work is an 8-place setting, and the one at my grandmother's is a 12-place setting, but there wasn't as big a difference as I thought. So I assumed the My Dear dishwasher would be the same. But wow. The interior space is spacious, and the bottom is tall, so pots slide right in. I can actually use quite a lot of space. Especially when you eat a meal, you need spoons, plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and pots—you know, that's a lot. I thought I could just use the top or bottom sections! + The sink area looks much cleaner. Since there is no drying rack, the cooking space at the sink has expanded, which I love so much! Rocket Installation, Rocket Delivery. I seriously got a +10,000,000 rating for Rocket Installation. Since it's an old apartment, the faucets were worn out, and I wanted to have a pantry installed along with it, so I had prepared a pantry. I had planned to install the dishwasher first and then insert the pantry once the technician left. However, the technician readily agreed that it would be better to watch the installation process together. The technician personally helped install the pantry. He also checked to see if the drain pipes or other wires were interfering with it. He tested everything and left. Right after he left, I ran the dishwasher and took a nap. When I woke up, the living room was flooded. Shocked, I called the technician to let him know, and he came right away! He said that after checking, the sink faucet seemed to be the primary cause, and that if the water continued to leak even after fixing the faucet, it would likely be a problem with the dishwasher. (Honestly, if the sink faucet were the primary cause, he could have just told me to call someone else to fix it first.) However, since it was Sunday and the hardware store probably wouldn't be open, he said he would go to the hardware store on Monday to buy a new faucet, fix the dishwasher, and then check for the secondary cause. He came back to our house the next day at 10 am. After fixing the sink faucet and checking for a mechanical defect, it turned out that wasn't the case. Thanks to him, we now have a dishwasher and can use a new sink faucet. I am so sorry and grateful. I was so touched that you checked everything so thoroughly and took responsibility until the very end. My Dear itself is great, but thanks to the technician, I gained trust in Coupang Rocket Installation. I don't know if you will read this, but thank you so much! Downsides. Actually, there are no downsides yet. I already knew how to use a dishwasher to some extent from looking at the one at my company, even though the brand is different. Also, I don't have the confidence to remove food particles stuck in the dishwasher myself. So, I rinse out solid food scraps and chili powder with water beforehand (and plan to continue doing so). Electricity costs. I think it might be cheaper than my own labor. If any downsides arise, I will come back to write about them. +++++. 26.03.25. Downsides. I think I understand what you mean about it not drying. Since I only eat dinner on weekdays, I use the dishwasher in the evening as well. I run the dishwasher tonight, and then tomorrow evening, I take the dishes out, organize them, and put in the dishes from that day's dinner. However, I discovered a downside over the weekend. Since I eat breakfast, lunch, and dinner with the kids on the weekend, I ran the dishwasher around lunchtime. When I went to clean up in the evening, I found there was still moisture, making it difficult to tidy up immediately. Because we have a dishwasher, we don't use a separate drying rack; we just use the cup holder on the sink. So, it is a bit of a shame that I can't clean up right away. At work, I use an LG dishwasher, and even that wasn't completely dry after it finished. The difference is that the LG dishwasher leaves just a few droplets of water, whereas the My Dear dishwasher leaves water dripping down. The cleaning power is good, so I am satisfied!

The next day, I ran it on the standard top and bottom cycle without adding extra drying. After a while, I checked and found that there was water on the bottom but none on the top! 2. However, you can set it to run only the top or bottom section. So, I liked that I could run it without worry even when the amount of dishes was small. 2. There is a multi-purpose basket on top. I'm using it in the multi-purpose basket! 3. It's wider and bigger than I expected. Especially when you eat a meal, you need spoons, plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and pots—you know, that's a lot. Rocket Installation, Rocket Delivery. I seriously got a +10,000,000 rating for Rocket Installation. I had planned to install the dishwasher first and then insert the pantry once the technician left. He also checked to see if the drain pipes or other wires were interfering with it. He tested everything and left. Right after he left, I ran the dishwasher and took a nap. When I woke up, the living room was flooded. Shocked, I called the technician to let him know, and he came right away! He said that after checking, the sink faucet seemed to be the primary cause, and that if the water continued to leak even after fixing the faucet, it would likely be a problem with the dishwasher. (Honestly, if the sink faucet were the primary cause, he could have just told me to call someone else to fix it first.) However, since it was Sunday and the hardware store probably wouldn't be open, he said he would go to the hardware store on Monday to buy a new faucet, fix the dishwasher, and then check for the secondary cause. He came back to our house the next day at 10 am. After fixing the sink faucet and checking for a mechanical defect, it turned out that wasn't the case. Thanks to him, we now have a dishwasher and can use a new sink faucet. I am so sorry and grateful. I was so touched that you checked everything so thoroughly and took responsibility until the very end. My Dear itself is great, but thanks to the technician, I gained trust in Coupang Rocket Installation. I don't know if you will read this, but thank you so much! Downsides. Actually, there are no downsides yet. I already knew how to use a dishwasher to some extent from looking at the one at my company, even though the brand is different. Also, I don't have the confidence to remove food particles stuck in the dishwasher myself. So, I rinse out solid food scraps and chili powder with water beforehand (and plan to continue doing so). Especially when you eat a meal, you need spoons, plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and pots—you know, that's a lot. Rocket Installation, Rocket Delivery. I seriously got a +10,000,000 rating for Rocket Installation. (Honestly, if the sink faucet were the primary cause, he could have just told me to call someone else to fix it first.) However, since it was Sunday and the hardware store probably wouldn't be open, he said he would go to the hardware store on Monday to buy a new faucet, fix the dishwasher, and then check for the secondary cause. He came back to our house the next day at 10 am. After fixing the sink faucet and checking for a mechanical defect, it turned out that wasn't the case. Thanks to him, we now have a dishwasher and can use a new sink faucet. I am so sorry and grateful. I was so touched that you checked everything so thoroughly and took responsibility until the very end. My Dear itself is great, but thanks to the technician, I gained trust in Coupang Rocket Installation. I don't know if you will read this, but thank you so much! Downsides. Actually, there are no downsides yet. I already knew how to use a dishwasher to some extent from looking at the one at my company, even though the brand is different. Also, I don't have the confidence to remove food particles stuck in the dishwasher myself. So, I rinse out solid food scraps and chili powder with water beforehand (and plan to continue doing so). Electricity costs. I think it might be cheaper than my own labor. If any downsides arise, I will come back to write about them. +++++. 26.03.25. Downsides. I think I understand what you mean about it not drying. Since I only eat dinner on weekdays, I use the dishwasher in the evening as well. I run the dishwasher tonight, and then tomorrow evening, I take the dishes out, organize them, and put in the dishes from that day's dinner. However, I discovered a downside over the weekend. When I went to clean up in the evening, I found there was still moisture, making it difficult to tidy up immediately. Because we have a dishwasher, we don't use a separate drying rack; we just use the cup holder on the sink. So, it is a bit of a shame that I can't clean up right away. Comments (English): [ I am super, super, super satisfied—so much so that the time I spent hesitating was a waste! ] || ---------------- || I debated this for 3-4 months, but I should have done it sooner. I am so satisfied! My main concerns were two things: 1. That it doesn't dry well? Just in case, I added extra drying mode the first time and ran only the top section, and there was no water. The next day, I ran it on the standard top and bottom cycle without adding extra drying. After a while, I checked and found that there was water on the bottom but none on the top! 2. Would it install in an old apartment? My apartment is old, so there isn't even a separate shut-off valve for the sink water. The technician came and installed it perfectly! ***. Advantages of the My Dear Dishwasher: 1. You can run the top and bottom sections separately. It feels wasteful to run the dishwasher when there are only a few dishes. However, you can set it to run only the top or bottom section. So, I liked that I could run it without worry even when the amount of dishes was small. 2. There is a multi-purpose basket on top. I keep my spoons and chopsticks in the multi-purpose basket on top. Although there is a cutlery holder, I feel like keeping them separate helps them clean better. I'm using it in the multi-purpose basket! 3. It's wider and bigger than I expected. The dishwasher at work is an 8-place setting, and the one at my grandmother's is a 12-place setting, but there wasn't as big a difference as I thought. So I assumed the My Dear dishwasher would be the same. But wow. The interior space is spacious, and the bottom is tall, so pots slide right in. I can actually use quite a lot of space. Especially when you eat a meal, you need spoons, plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and pots—you know, that's a lot. I thought I could just use the top or bottom sections! + The sink area looks much cleaner. Since there is no drying rack, the cooking space at the sink has expanded, which I love so much! Rocket Installation, Rocket Delivery. I seriously got a +10,000,000 rating for Rocket Installation. Since it's an old apartment, the faucets were worn out, and I wanted to have a pantry installed along with it, so I had prepared a pantry. I had planned to install the dishwasher first and then insert the pantry once the technician left. However, the technician readily agreed that it would be better to watch the installation process together. The technician personally helped install the pantry. He also checked to see if the drain pipes or other wires were interfering with it. He tested everything and left. Right after he left, I ran the dishwasher and took a nap. When I woke up, the living room was flooded. Shocked, I called the technician to let him know, and he came right away! He said that after checking, the sink faucet seemed to be the primary cause, and that if the water continued to leak even after fixing the faucet, it would likely be a problem with the dishwasher. (Honestly, if the sink faucet were the primary cause, he could have just told me to call someone else to fix it first.) However, since it was Sunday and the hardware store probably wouldn't be open, he said he would go to the hardware store on Monday to buy a new faucet, fix the dishwasher, and then check for the secondary cause. He came back to our house the next day at 10 am. After fixing the sink faucet and checking for a mechanical defect, it turned out that wasn't the case. Thanks to him, we now have a dishwasher and can use a new sink faucet. I am so sorry and grateful. I was so touched that you checked everything so thoroughly and took responsibility until the very end. My Dear itself is great, but thanks to the technician, I gained trust in Coupang Rocket Installation. I don't know if you will read this, but thank you so much! Downsides. Actually, there are no downsides yet. I already knew how to use a dishwasher to some extent from looking at the one at my company, even though the brand is different. Also, I don't have the confidence to remove food particles stuck in the dishwasher myself. So, I rinse out solid food scraps and chili powder with water beforehand (and plan to continue doing so). Electricity costs. I think it might be cheaper than my own labor. If any downsides arise, I will come back to write about them. +++++. 26.03.25. Downsides. I think I understand what you mean about it not drying. Since I only eat dinner on weekdays, I use the dishwasher in the evening as well. I run the dishwasher tonight, and then tomorrow evening, I take the dishes out, organize them, and put in the dishes from that day's dinner. However, I discovered a downside over the weekend. Since I eat breakfast, lunch, and dinner with the kids on the weekend, I ran the dishwasher around lunchtime. When I went to clean up in the evening, I found there was still moisture, making it difficult to tidy up immediately. Because we have a dishwasher, we don't use a separate drying rack; we just use the cup holder on the sink. So, it is a bit of a shame that I can't clean up right away. At work, I use an LG dishwasher, and even that wasn't completely dry after it finished. The difference is that the LG dishwasher leaves just a few droplets of water, whereas the My Dear dishwasher leaves water dripping down. The cleaning power is good, so I am satisfied!

I keep my spoons and chopsticks in the multi-purpose basket on top. Although there is a cutlery holder, I feel like keeping them separate helps them clean better. I'm using it in the multi-purpose basket! 3. It's wider and bigger than I expected. I had planned to install the dishwasher first and then insert the pantry once the technician left. He also checked to see if the drain pipes or other wires were interfering with it. He tested everything and left. Right after he left, I ran the dishwasher and took a nap. When I woke up, the living room was flooded. Shocked, I called the technician to let him know, and he came right away! He said that after checking, the sink faucet seemed to be the primary cause, and that if the water continued to leak even after fixing the faucet, it would likely be a problem with the dishwasher. (Honestly, if the sink faucet were the primary cause, he could have just told me to call someone else to fix it first.) However, since it was Sunday and the hardware store probably wouldn't be open, he said he would go to the hardware store on Monday to buy a new faucet, fix the dishwasher, and then check for the secondary cause. He came back to our house the next day at 10 am. After fixing the sink faucet and checking for a mechanical defect, it turned out that wasn't the case. Thanks to him, we now have a dishwasher and can use a new sink faucet. I am so sorry and grateful. I was so touched that you checked everything so thoroughly and took responsibility until the very end. Actually, there are no downsides yet. I already knew how to use a dishwasher to some extent from looking at the one at my company, even though the brand is different. Also, I don't have the confidence to remove food particles stuck in the dishwasher myself. So, I rinse out solid food scraps and chili powder with water beforehand (and plan to continue doing so). Advantages of the My Dear Dishwasher: 1. You can run the top and bottom sections separately. It feels wasteful to run the dishwasher when there are only a few dishes. Especially when you eat a meal, you need spoons, plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and pots—you know, that's a lot. I thought I could just use the top or bottom sections! + The sink area looks much cleaner. Since there is no drying rack, the cooking space at the sink has expanded, which I love so much! Rocket Installation, Rocket Delivery. I seriously got a +10,000,000 rating for Rocket Installation. Since it's an old apartment, the faucets were worn out, and I wanted to have a pantry installed along with it, so I had prepared a pantry. He also checked to see if the drain pipes or other wires were interfering with it. He tested everything and left. Right after he left, I ran the dishwasher and took a nap. When I woke up, the living room was flooded. Shocked, I called the technician to let him know, and he came right away! He said that after checking, the sink faucet seemed to be the primary cause, and that if the water continued to leak even after fixing the faucet, it would likely be a problem with the dishwasher. (Honestly, if the sink faucet were the primary cause, he could have just told me to call someone else to fix it first.) However, since it was Sunday and the hardware store probably wouldn't be open, he said he would go to the hardware store on Monday to buy a new faucet, fix the dishwasher, and then check for the secondary cause. He came back to our house the next day at 10 am. After fixing the sink faucet and checking for a mechanical defect, it turned out that wasn't the case. Thanks to him, we now have a dishwasher and can use a new sink faucet. I am so sorry and grateful. I was so touched that you checked everything so thoroughly and took responsibility until the very end. My Dear itself is great, but thanks to the technician, I gained trust in Coupang Rocket Installation. I don't know if you will read this, but thank you so much! Downsides. Actually, there are no downsides yet. I already knew how to use a dishwasher to some extent from looking at the one at my company, even though the brand is different. Also, I don't have the confidence to remove food particles stuck in the dishwasher myself. So, I rinse out solid food scraps and chili powder with water beforehand (and plan to continue doing so). Electricity costs. I think it might be cheaper than my own labor. If any downsides arise, I will come back to write about them. +++++. 26.03.25. Downsides. I think I understand what you mean about it not drying. Since I only eat dinner on weekdays, I use the dishwasher in the evening as well. I run the dishwasher tonight, and then tomorrow evening, I take the dishes out, organize them, and put in the dishes from that day's dinner. However, I discovered a downside over the weekend. Because we have a dishwasher, we don't use a separate drying rack; we just use the cup holder on the sink. So, it is a bit of a shame that I can't clean up right away. The difference is that the LG dishwasher leaves just a few droplets of water, whereas the My Dear dishwasher leaves water dripping down. The cleaning power is good, so I am satisfied!

(Honestly, if the sink faucet were the primary cause, he could have just told me to call someone else to fix it first.) However, since it was Sunday and the hardware store probably wouldn't be open, he said he would go to the hardware store on Monday to buy a new faucet, fix the dishwasher, and then check for the secondary cause. The next day, I ran it on the standard top and bottom cycle without adding extra drying. After a while, I checked and found that there was water on the bottom but none on the top! 2. Would it install in an old apartment? My apartment is old, so there isn't even a separate shut-off valve for the sink water. The technician came and installed it perfectly! ***. Advantages of the My Dear Dishwasher: 1. You can run the top and bottom sections separately. It feels wasteful to run the dishwasher when there are only a few dishes. However, you can set it to run only the top or bottom section. So, I liked that I could run it without worry even when the amount of dishes was small. 2. There is a multi-purpose basket on top. I keep my spoons and chopsticks in the multi-purpose basket on top. Although there is a cutlery holder, I feel like keeping them separate helps them clean better. I'm using it in the multi-purpose basket! 3. It's wider and bigger than I expected. The dishwasher at work is an 8-place setting, and the one at my grandmother's is a 12-place setting, but there wasn't as big a difference as I thought. So I assumed the My Dear dishwasher would be the same. But wow. The interior space is spacious, and the bottom is tall, so pots slide right in. I can actually use quite a lot of space. Especially when you eat a meal, you need spoons, plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and pots—you know, that's a lot. I thought I could just use the top or bottom sections! + The sink area looks much cleaner. Since there is no drying rack, the cooking space at the sink has expanded, which I love so much! Rocket Installation, Rocket Delivery. I seriously got a +10,000,000 rating for Rocket Installation. Since it's an old apartment, the faucets were worn out, and I wanted to have a pantry installed along with it, so I had prepared a pantry. I had planned to install the dishwasher first and then insert the pantry once the technician left. However, the technician readily agreed that it would be better to watch the installation process together. The technician personally helped install the pantry. He also checked to see if the drain pipes or other wires were interfering with it. He tested everything and left. Right after he left, I ran the dishwasher and took a nap. When I woke up, the living room was flooded. Shocked, I called the technician to let him know, and he came right away! He said that after checking, the sink faucet seemed to be the primary cause, and that if the water continued to leak even after fixing the faucet, it would likely be a problem with the dishwasher. (Honestly, if the sink faucet were the primary cause, he could have just told me to call someone else to fix it first.) However, since it was Sunday and the hardware store probably wouldn't be open, he said he would go to the hardware store on Monday to buy a new faucet, fix the dishwasher, and then check for the secondary cause. He came back to our house the next day at 10 am. After fixing the sink faucet and checking for a mechanical defect, it turned out that wasn't the case. Thanks to him, we now have a dishwasher and can use a new sink faucet. I am so sorry and grateful. I was so touched that you checked everything so thoroughly and took responsibility until the very end. My Dear itself is great, but thanks to the technician, I gained trust in Coupang Rocket Installation. I don't know if you will read this, but thank you so much! Downsides. Actually, there are no downsides yet. I already knew how to use a dishwasher to some extent from looking at the one at my company, even though the brand is different. Also, I don't have the confidence to remove food particles stuck in the dishwasher myself. So, I rinse out solid food scraps and chili powder with water beforehand (and plan to continue doing so). Electricity costs. I think it might be cheaper than my own labor. If any downsides arise, I will come back to write about them. +++++. 26.03.25. Downsides. I think I understand what you mean about it not drying. Since I only eat dinner on weekdays, I use the dishwasher in the evening as well. I run the dishwasher tonight, and then tomorrow evening, I take the dishes out, organize them, and put in the dishes from that day's dinner. However, I discovered a downside over the weekend. Since I eat breakfast, lunch, and dinner with the kids on the weekend, I ran the dishwasher around lunchtime. When I went to clean up in the evening, I found there was still moisture, making it difficult to tidy up immediately. Because we have a dishwasher, we don't use a separate drying rack; we just use the cup holder on the sink. So, it is a bit of a shame that I can't clean up right away. At work, I use an LG dishwasher, and even that wasn't completely dry after it finished. The difference is that the LG dishwasher leaves just a few droplets of water, whereas the My Dear dishwasher leaves water dripping down. The cleaning power is good, so I am satisfied!

I am so satisfied! My main concerns were two things: 1. That it doesn't dry well? Just in case, I added extra drying mode the first time and ran only the top section, and there was no water. The next day, I ran it on the standard top and bottom cycle without adding extra drying. After a while, I checked and found that there was water on the bottom but none on the top! 2. Would it install in an old apartment? My apartment is old, so there isn't even a separate shut-off valve for the sink water. The technician came and installed it perfectly! ***. Advantages of the My Dear Dishwasher: 1. You can run the top and bottom sections separately. It feels wasteful to run the dishwasher when there are only a few dishes. However, you can set it to run only the top or bottom section. So, I liked that I could run it without worry even when the amount of dishes was small. 2. There is a multi-purpose basket on top. I keep my spoons and chopsticks in the multi-purpose basket on top. Although there is a cutlery holder, I feel like keeping them separate helps them clean better. I'm using it in the multi-purpose basket! 3. It's wider and bigger than I expected. The dishwasher at work is an 8-place setting, and the one at my grandmother's is a 12-place setting, but there wasn't as big a difference as I thought. So I assumed the My Dear dishwasher would be the same. But wow. The interior space is spacious, and the bottom is tall, so pots slide right in. I can actually use quite a lot of space. Especially when you eat a meal, you need spoons, plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and pots—you know, that's a lot. I thought I could just use the top or bottom sections! + The sink area looks much cleaner. Since there is no drying rack, the cooking space at the sink has expanded, which I love so much! Rocket Installation, Rocket Delivery. I seriously got a +10,000,000 rating for Rocket Installation. Since it's an old apartment, the faucets were worn out, and I wanted to have a pantry installed along with it, so I had prepared a pantry. I had planned to install the dishwasher first and then insert the pantry once the technician left. However, the technician readily agreed that it would be better to watch the installation process together. The technician personally helped install the pantry. He also checked to see if the drain pipes or other wires were interfering with it. He tested everything and left. Right after he left, I ran the dishwasher and took a nap. When I woke up, the living room was flooded. Shocked, I called the technician to let him know, and he came right away! He said that after checking, the sink faucet seemed to be the primary cause, and that if the water continued to leak even after fixing the faucet, it would likely be a problem with the dishwasher. (Honestly, if the sink faucet were the primary cause, he could have just told me to call someone else to fix it first.) However, since it was Sunday and the hardware store probably wouldn't be open, he said he would go to the hardware store on Monday to buy a new faucet, fix the dishwasher, and then check for the secondary cause. He came back to our house the next day at 10 am. After fixing the sink faucet and checking for a mechanical defect, it turned out that wasn't the case. Thanks to him, we now have a dishwasher and can use a new sink faucet. I am so sorry and grateful. I was so touched that you checked everything so thoroughly and took responsibility until the very end. My Dear itself is great, but thanks to the technician, I gained trust in Coupang Rocket Installation. I don't know if you will read this, but thank you so much! Downsides. Actually, there are no downsides yet. I already knew how to use a dishwasher to some extent from looking at the one at my company, even though the brand is different. Also, I don't have the confidence to remove food particles stuck in the dishwasher myself. So, I rinse out solid food scraps and chili powder with water beforehand (and plan to continue doing so). Electricity costs. I think it might be cheaper than my own labor. If any downsides arise, I will come back to write about them. +++++. 26.03.25. Downsides. I think I understand what you mean about it not drying. Since I only eat dinner on weekdays, I use the dishwasher in the evening as well. I run the dishwasher tonight, and then tomorrow evening, I take the dishes out, organize them, and put in the dishes from that day's dinner. However, I discovered a downside over the weekend. Since I eat breakfast, lunch, and dinner with the kids on the weekend, I ran the dishwasher around lunchtime. When I went to clean up in the evening, I found there was still moisture, making it difficult to tidy up immediately. Because we have a dishwasher, we don't use a separate drying rack; we just use the cup holder on the sink. So, it is a bit of a shame that I can't clean up right away. At work, I use an LG dishwasher, and even that wasn't completely dry after it finished. The difference is that the LG dishwasher leaves just a few droplets of water, whereas the My Dear dishwasher leaves water dripping down. The cleaning power is good, so I am satisfied!

Comments (English): [ I am super, super, super satisfied—so much so that the time I spent hesitating was a waste! ] || ---------------- || I debated this for 3-4 months, but I should have done it sooner. I am so satisfied! My main concerns were two things: 1. That it doesn't dry well? Just in case, I added extra drying mode the first time and ran only the top section, and there was no water. The next day, I ran it on the standard top and bottom cycle without adding extra drying. After a while, I checked and found that there was water on the bottom but none on the top! 2. Would it install in an old apartment? My apartment is old, so there isn't even a separate shut-off valve for the sink water. The technician came and installed it perfectly! ***. Advantages of the My Dear Dishwasher: 1. You can run the top and bottom sections separately. It feels wasteful to run the dishwasher when there are only a few dishes. However, you can set it to run only the top or bottom section. So, I liked that I could run it without worry even when the amount of dishes was small. 2. There is a multi-purpose basket on top. I keep my spoons and chopsticks in the multi-purpose basket on top. Although there is a cutlery holder, I feel like keeping them separate helps them clean better. I'm using it in the multi-purpose basket! 3. It's wider and bigger than I expected. The dishwasher at work is an 8-place setting, and the one at my grandmother's is a 12-place setting, but there wasn't as big a difference as I thought. So I assumed the My Dear dishwasher would be the same. But wow. The interior space is spacious, and the bottom is tall, so pots slide right in. I can actually use quite a lot of space. Especially when you eat a meal, you need spoons, plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and pots—you know, that's a lot. I thought I could just use the top or bottom sections! + The sink area looks much cleaner. Since there is no drying rack, the cooking space at the sink has expanded, which I love so much! Rocket Installation, Rocket Delivery. I seriously got a +10,000,000 rating for Rocket Installation. Since it's an old apartment, the faucets were worn out, and I wanted to have a pantry installed along with it, so I had prepared a pantry. I had planned to install the dishwasher first and then insert the pantry once the technician left. However, the technician readily agreed that it would be better to watch the installation process together. The technician personally helped install the pantry. He also checked to see if the drain pipes or other wires were interfering with it. He tested everything and left. Right after he left, I ran the dishwasher and took a nap. When I woke up, the living room was flooded. Shocked, I called the technician to let him know, and he came right away! He said that after checking, the sink faucet seemed to be the primary cause, and that if the water continued to leak even after fixing the faucet, it would likely be a problem with the dishwasher. (Honestly, if the sink faucet were the primary cause, he could have just told me to call someone else to fix it first.) However, since it was Sunday and the hardware store probably wouldn't be open, he said he would go to the hardware store on Monday to buy a new faucet, fix the dishwasher, and then check for the secondary cause. He came back to our house the next day at 10 am. After fixing the sink faucet and checking for a mechanical defect, it turned out that wasn't the case. Thanks to him, we now have a dishwasher and can use a new sink faucet. I am so sorry and grateful. I was so touched that you checked everything so thoroughly and took responsibility until the very end. My Dear itself is great, but thanks to the technician, I gained trust in Coupang Rocket Installation. I don't know if you will read this, but thank you so much! Downsides. Actually, there are no downsides yet. I already knew how to use a dishwasher to some extent from looking at the one at my company, even though the brand is different. Also, I don't have the confidence to remove food particles stuck in the dishwasher myself. So, I rinse out solid food scraps and chili powder with water beforehand (and plan to continue doing so). Electricity costs. I think it might be cheaper than my own labor. If any downsides arise, I will come back to write about them. +++++. 26.03.25. Downsides. I think I understand what you mean about it not drying. Since I only eat dinner on weekdays, I use the dishwasher in the evening as well. I run the dishwasher tonight, and then tomorrow evening, I take the dishes out, organize them, and put in the dishes from that day's dinner. However, I discovered a downside over the weekend. Since I eat breakfast, lunch, and dinner with the kids on the weekend, I ran the dishwasher around lunchtime. When I went to clean up in the evening, I found there was still moisture, making it difficult to tidy up immediately. Because we have a dishwasher, we don't use a separate drying rack; we just use the cup holder on the sink. So, it is a bit of a shame that I can't clean up right away. At work, I use an LG dishwasher, and even that wasn't completely dry after it finished. The difference is that the LG dishwasher leaves just a few droplets of water, whereas the My Dear dishwasher leaves water dripping down. The cleaning power is good, so I am satisfied!

Comments (English): [ I am super, super, super satisfied—so much so that the time I spent hesitating was a waste! ] || ---------------- || I debated this for 3-4 months, but I should have done it sooner. I am so satisfied! My main concerns were two things: 1. That it doesn't dry well? Just in case, I added extra drying mode the first time and ran only the top section, and there was no water. The next day, I ran it on the standard top and bottom cycle without adding extra drying. After a while, I checked and found that there was water on the bottom but none on the top! 2. Would it install in an old apartment? My apartment is old, so there isn't even a separate shut-off valve for the sink water. The technician came and installed it perfectly! ***. Advantages of the My Dear Dishwasher: 1. You can run the top and bottom sections separately. It feels wasteful to run the dishwasher when there are only a few dishes. However, you can set it to run only the top or bottom section. So, I liked that I could run it without worry even when the amount of dishes was small. 2. There is a multi-purpose basket on top. I keep my spoons and chopsticks in the multi-purpose basket on top. Although there is a cutlery holder, I feel like keeping them separate helps them clean better. I'm using it in the multi-purpose basket! 3. It's wider and bigger than I expected. The dishwasher at work is an 8-place setting, and the one at my grandmother's is a 12-place setting, but there wasn't as big a difference as I thought. So I assumed the My Dear dishwasher would be the same. But wow. The interior space is spacious, and the bottom is tall, so pots slide right in. I can actually use quite a lot of space. Especially when you eat a meal, you need spoons, plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and pots—you know, that's a lot. I thought I could just use the top or bottom sections! + The sink area looks much cleaner. Since there is no drying rack, the cooking space at the sink has expanded, which I love so much! Rocket Installation, Rocket Delivery. I seriously got a +10,000,000 rating for Rocket Installation. Since it's an old apartment, the faucets were worn out, and I wanted to have a pantry installed along with it, so I had prepared a pantry. I had planned to install the dishwasher first and then insert the pantry once the technician left. However, the technician readily agreed that it would be better to watch the installation process together. The technician personally helped install the pantry. He also checked to see if the drain pipes or other wires were interfering with it. He tested everything and left. Right after he left, I ran the dishwasher and took a nap. When I woke up, the living room was flooded. Shocked, I called the technician to let him know, and he came right away! He said that after checking, the sink faucet seemed to be the primary cause, and that if the water continued to leak even after fixing the faucet, it would likely be a problem with the dishwasher. (Honestly, if the sink faucet were the primary cause, he could have just told me to call someone else to fix it first.) However, since it was Sunday and the hardware store probably wouldn't be open, he said he would go to the hardware store on Monday to buy a new faucet, fix the dishwasher, and then check for the secondary cause. He came back to our house the next day at 10 am. After fixing the sink faucet and checking for a mechanical defect, it turned out that wasn't the case. Thanks to him, we now have a dishwasher and can use a new sink faucet. I am so sorry and grateful. I was so touched that you checked everything so thoroughly and took responsibility until the very end. My Dear itself is great, but thanks to the technician, I gained trust in Coupang Rocket Installation. I don't know if you will read this, but thank you so much! Downsides. Actually, there are no downsides yet. I already knew how to use a dishwasher to some extent from looking at the one at my company, even though the brand is different. Also, I don't have the confidence to remove food particles stuck in the dishwasher myself. So, I rinse out solid food scraps and chili powder with water beforehand (and plan to continue doing so). Electricity costs. I think it might be cheaper than my own labor. If any downsides arise, I will come back to write about them. +++++. 26.03.25. Downsides. I think I understand what you mean about it not drying. Since I only eat dinner on weekdays, I use the dishwasher in the evening as well. I run the dishwasher tonight, and then tomorrow evening, I take the dishes out, organize them, and put in the dishes from that day's dinner. However, I discovered a downside over the weekend. Since I eat breakfast, lunch, and dinner with the kids on the weekend, I ran the dishwasher around lunchtime. When I went to clean up in the evening, I found there was still moisture, making it difficult to tidy up immediately. Because we have a dishwasher, we don't use a separate drying rack; we just use the cup holder on the sink. So, it is a bit of a shame that I can't clean up right away. At work, I use an LG dishwasher, and even that wasn't completely dry after it finished. The difference is that the LG dishwasher leaves just a few droplets of water, whereas the My Dear dishwasher leaves water dripping down. The cleaning power is good, so I am satisfied!

Comments (English): [ I am super, super, super satisfied—so much so that the time I spent hesitating was a waste! ] || ---------------- || I debated this for 3-4 months, but I should have done it sooner. The next day, I ran it on the standard top and bottom cycle without adding extra drying. After a while, I checked and found that there was water on the bottom but none on the top! 2. Would it install in an old apartment? My apartment is old, so there isn't even a separate shut-off valve for the sink water. The technician came and installed it perfectly! ***. Advantages of the My Dear Dishwasher: 1. You can run the top and bottom sections separately. It feels wasteful to run the dishwasher when there are only a few dishes. However, you can set it to run only the top or bottom section. So, I liked that I could run it without worry even when the amount of dishes was small. 2. There is a multi-purpose basket on top. I keep my spoons and chopsticks in the multi-purpose basket on top. Although there is a cutlery holder, I feel like keeping them separate helps them clean better. I'm using it in the multi-purpose basket! 3. It's wider and bigger than I expected. The dishwasher at work is an 8-place setting, and the one at my grandmother's is a 12-place setting, but there wasn't as big a difference as I thought. So I assumed the My Dear dishwasher would be the same. But wow. The interior space is spacious, and the bottom is tall, so pots slide right in. I can actually use quite a lot of space. Especially when you eat a meal, you need spoons, plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and pots—you know, that's a lot. I thought I could just use the top or bottom sections! + The sink area looks much cleaner. Since there is no drying rack, the cooking space at the sink has expanded, which I love so much! Rocket Installation, Rocket Delivery. I seriously got a +10,000,000 rating for Rocket Installation. Since it's an old apartment, the faucets were worn out, and I wanted to have a pantry installed along with it, so I had prepared a pantry. I had planned to install the dishwasher first and then insert the pantry once the technician left. However, the technician readily agreed that it would be better to watch the installation process together. The technician personally helped install the pantry. He also checked to see if the drain pipes or other wires were interfering with it. He tested everything and left. Right after he left, I ran the dishwasher and took a nap. When I woke up, the living room was flooded. Shocked, I called the technician to let him know, and he came right away! He said that after checking, the sink faucet seemed to be the primary cause, and that if the water continued to leak even after fixing the faucet, it would likely be a problem with the dishwasher. (Honestly, if the sink faucet were the primary cause, he could have just told me to call someone else to fix it first.) However, since it was Sunday and the hardware store probably wouldn't be open, he said he would go to the hardware store on Monday to buy a new faucet, fix the dishwasher, and then check for the secondary cause. He came back to our house the next day at 10 am. After fixing the sink faucet and checking for a mechanical defect, it turned out that wasn't the case. Thanks to him, we now have a dishwasher and can use a new sink faucet. I am so sorry and grateful. I was so touched that you checked everything so thoroughly and took responsibility until the very end. My Dear itself is great, but thanks to the technician, I gained trust in Coupang Rocket Installation. I don't know if you will read this, but thank you so much! Downsides. Actually, there are no downsides yet. I already knew how to use a dishwasher to some extent from looking at the one at my company, even though the brand is different. Also, I don't have the confidence to remove food particles stuck in the dishwasher myself. So, I rinse out solid food scraps and chili powder with water beforehand (and plan to continue doing so). Electricity costs. I think it might be cheaper than my own labor. If any downsides arise, I will come back to write about them. +++++. 26.03.25. Downsides. I think I understand what you mean about it not drying. Since I only eat dinner on weekdays, I use the dishwasher in the evening as well. I run the dishwasher tonight, and then tomorrow evening, I take the dishes out, organize them, and put in the dishes from that day's dinner. However, I discovered a downside over the weekend. Since I eat breakfast, lunch, and dinner with the kids on the weekend, I ran the dishwasher around lunchtime. When I went to clean up in the evening, I found there was still moisture, making it difficult to tidy up immediately. Because we have a dishwasher, we don't use a separate drying rack; we just use the cup holder on the sink. So, it is a bit of a shame that I can't clean up right away. At work, I use an LG dishwasher, and even that wasn't completely dry after it finished. The difference is that the LG dishwasher leaves just a few droplets of water, whereas the My Dear dishwasher leaves water dripping down. The cleaning power is good, so I am satisfied!

Comments (English): [ I am super, super, super satisfied—so much so that the time I spent hesitating was a waste! ] || ---------------- || I debated this for 3-4 months, but I should have done it sooner. I am so satisfied! My main concerns were two things: 1. That it doesn't dry well? Just in case, I added extra drying mode the first time and ran only the top section, and there was no water. The next day, I ran it on the standard top and bottom cycle without adding extra drying. After a while, I checked and found that there was water on the bottom but none on the top! 2. Would it install in an old apartment? My apartment is old, so there isn't even a separate shut-off valve for the sink water. The technician came and installed it perfectly! ***. Advantages of the My Dear Dishwasher: 1. You can run the top and bottom sections separately. It feels wasteful to run the dishwasher when there are only a few dishes. However, you can set it to run only the top or bottom section. So, I liked that I could run it without worry even when the amount of dishes was small. 2. There is a multi-purpose basket on top. I keep my spoons and chopsticks in the multi-purpose basket on top. Although there is a cutlery holder, I feel like keeping them separate helps them clean better. I'm using it in the multi-purpose basket! 3. It's wider and bigger than I expected. The dishwasher at work is an 8-place setting, and the one at my grandmother's is a 12-place setting, but there wasn't as big a difference as I thought. So I assumed the My Dear dishwasher would be the same. But wow. The interior space is spacious, and the bottom is tall, so pots slide right in. I can actually use quite a lot of space. Especially when you eat a meal, you need spoons, plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and pots—you know, that's a lot. I thought I could just use the top or bottom sections! + The sink area looks much cleaner. Since there is no drying rack, the cooking space at the sink has expanded, which I love so much! Rocket Installation, Rocket Delivery. I seriously got a +10,000,000 rating for Rocket Installation. Since it's an old apartment, the faucets were worn out, and I wanted to have a pantry installed along with it, so I had prepared a pantry. I had planned to install the dishwasher first and then insert the pantry once the technician left. However, the technician readily agreed that it would be better to watch the installation process together. The technician personally helped install the pantry. He also checked to see if the drain pipes or other wires were interfering with it. He tested everything and left. Right after he left, I ran the dishwasher and took a nap. When I woke up, the living room was flooded. Shocked, I called the technician to let him know, and he came right away! He said that after checking, the sink faucet seemed to be the primary cause, and that if the water continued to leak even after fixing the faucet, it would likely be a problem with the dishwasher. (Honestly, if the sink faucet were the primary cause, he could have just told me to call someone else to fix it first.) However, since it was Sunday and the hardware store probably wouldn't be open, he said he would go to the hardware store on Monday to buy a new faucet, fix the dishwasher, and then check for the secondary cause. He came back to our house the next day at 10 am. After fixing the sink faucet and checking for a mechanical defect, it turned out that wasn't the case. Thanks to him, we now have a dishwasher and can use a new sink faucet. I am so sorry and grateful. I was so touched that you checked everything so thoroughly and took responsibility until the very end. My Dear itself is great, but thanks to the technician, I gained trust in Coupang Rocket Installation. I don't know if you will read this, but thank you so much! Downsides. Actually, there are no downsides yet. I already knew how to use a dishwasher to some extent from looking at the one at my company, even though the brand is different. Also, I don't have the confidence to remove food particles stuck in the dishwasher myself. So, I rinse out solid food scraps and chili powder with water beforehand (and plan to continue doing so). Electricity costs. I think it might be cheaper than my own labor. If any downsides arise, I will come back to write about them. +++++. 26.03.25. Downsides. I think I understand what you mean about it not drying. Since I only eat dinner on weekdays, I use the dishwasher in the evening as well. I run the dishwasher tonight, and then tomorrow evening, I take the dishes out, organize them, and put in the dishes from that day's dinner. However, I discovered a downside over the weekend. Since I eat breakfast, lunch, and dinner with the kids on the weekend, I ran the dishwasher around lunchtime. When I went to clean up in the evening, I found there was still moisture, making it difficult to tidy up immediately. Because we have a dishwasher, we don't use a separate drying rack; we just use the cup holder on the sink. So, it is a bit of a shame that I can't clean up right away. At work, I use an LG dishwasher, and even that wasn't completely dry after it finished. The difference is that the LG dishwasher leaves just a few droplets of water, whereas the My Dear dishwasher leaves water dripping down. The cleaning power is good, so I am satisfied!
