Advantages of the My Dear Dishwasher: 1. You can run the top and bottom sections separately. It feels wasteful to run the dishwasher when there are only a few dishes. However, you can set it to run only the top or bottom section. So, I liked that I could run it without worry even when the amount of dishes was small. 2. There is a multi-purpose basket on top. I keep my spoons and chopsticks in the multi-purpose basket on top. Although there is a cutlery holder, I feel like keeping them separate helps them clean better. I'm using it in the multi-purpose basket! 3. It's wider and bigger than I expected. The dishwasher at work is an 8-place setting, and the one at my grandmother's is a 12-place setting, but there wasn't as big a difference as I thought. So I assumed the My Dear dishwasher would be the same. But wow. The interior space is spacious, and the bottom is tall, so pots slide right in. I can actually use quite a lot of space. Especially when you eat a meal, you need spoons, plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and pots—you know, that's a lot. I thought I could just use the top or bottom sections! + The sink area looks much cleaner. Since there is no drying rack, the cooking space at the sink has expanded, which I love so much! Rocket Installation, Rocket Delivery. I seriously got a +10,000,000 rating for Rocket Installation. Since it's an old apartment, the faucets were worn out, and I wanted to have a pantry installed along with it, so I had prepared a pantry. I had planned to install the dishwasher first and then insert the pantry once the technician left. However, the technician readily agreed that it would be better to watch the installation process together. The technician personally helped install the pantry. He also checked to see if the drain pipes or other wires were interfering with it. He tested everything and left. Right after he left, I ran the dishwasher and took a nap. When I woke up, the living room was flooded. Shocked, I called the technician to let him know, and he came right away! He said that after checking, the sink faucet seemed to be the primary cause, and that if the water continued to leak even after fixing the faucet, it would likely be a problem with the dishwasher. (Honestly, if the sink faucet were the primary cause, he could have just told me to call someone else to fix it first.) However, since it was Sunday and the hardware store probably wouldn't be open, he said he would go to the hardware store on Monday to buy a new faucet, fix the dishwasher, and then check for the secondary cause. He came back to our house the next day at 10 am. After fixing the sink faucet and checking for a mechanical defect, it turned out that wasn't the case. Thanks to him, we now have a dishwasher and can use a new sink faucet. I am so sorry and grateful. I was so touched that you checked everything so thoroughly and took responsibility until the very end. My Dear itself is great, but thanks to the technician, I gained trust in Coupang Rocket Installation. I don't know if you will read this, but thank you so much! Downsides. Actually, there are no downsides yet. I already knew how to use a dishwasher to some extent from looking at the one at my company, even though the brand is different. Also, I don't have the confidence to remove food particles stuck in the dishwasher myself. So, I rinse out solid food scraps and chili powder with water beforehand (and plan to continue doing so). Electricity costs. I think it might be cheaper than my own labor. If any downsides arise, I will come back to write about them. +++++. 26.03.25. Downsides. I think I understand what you mean about it not drying. Since I only eat dinner on weekdays, I use the dishwasher in the evening as well. I run the dishwasher tonight, and then tomorrow evening, I take the dishes out, organize them, and put in the dishes from that day's dinner. However, I discovered a downside over the weekend. Since I eat breakfast, lunch, and dinner with the kids on the weekend, I ran the dishwasher around lunchtime. The difference is that the LG dishwasher leaves just a few droplets of water, whereas the My Dear dishwasher leaves water dripping down. The cleaning power is good, so I am satisfied!

However, since it was Sunday and the hardware store probably wouldn't be open, he said he would go to the hardware store on Monday to buy a new faucet, fix the dishwasher, and then check for the secondary cause. Thanks to him, we now have a dishwasher and can use a new sink faucet. I am so sorry and grateful. I think I understand what you mean about it not drying. Since I only eat dinner on weekdays, I use the dishwasher in the evening as well. Comments (English): [ I am super, super, super satisfied—so much so that the time I spent hesitating was a waste! ] || ---------------- || I debated this for 3-4 months, but I should have done it sooner. I am so satisfied! My main concerns were two things: 1. That it doesn't dry well? Just in case, I added extra drying mode the first time and ran only the top section, and there was no water. The next day, I ran it on the standard top and bottom cycle without adding extra drying. After a while, I checked and found that there was water on the bottom but none on the top! 2. Would it install in an old apartment? My apartment is old, so there isn't even a separate shut-off valve for the sink water. The technician came and installed it perfectly! ***. Advantages of the My Dear Dishwasher: 1. You can run the top and bottom sections separately. It feels wasteful to run the dishwasher when there are only a few dishes. However, you can set it to run only the top or bottom section. So, I liked that I could run it without worry even when the amount of dishes was small. 2. There is a multi-purpose basket on top. I keep my spoons and chopsticks in the multi-purpose basket on top. Although there is a cutlery holder, I feel like keeping them separate helps them clean better. I'm using it in the multi-purpose basket! 3. It's wider and bigger than I expected. The dishwasher at work is an 8-place setting, and the one at my grandmother's is a 12-place setting, but there wasn't as big a difference as I thought. So I assumed the My Dear dishwasher would be the same. But wow. The interior space is spacious, and the bottom is tall, so pots slide right in. I can actually use quite a lot of space. Especially when you eat a meal, you need spoons, plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and pots—you know, that's a lot. I thought I could just use the top or bottom sections! + The sink area looks much cleaner. Since there is no drying rack, the cooking space at the sink has expanded, which I love so much! Rocket Installation, Rocket Delivery. I seriously got a +10,000,000 rating for Rocket Installation. Since it's an old apartment, the faucets were worn out, and I wanted to have a pantry installed along with it, so I had prepared a pantry. I had planned to install the dishwasher first and then insert the pantry once the technician left. However, the technician readily agreed that it would be better to watch the installation process together. The technician personally helped install the pantry. He also checked to see if the drain pipes or other wires were interfering with it. He tested everything and left. Right after he left, I ran the dishwasher and took a nap. When I woke up, the living room was flooded. Shocked, I called the technician to let him know, and he came right away! He said that after checking, the sink faucet seemed to be the primary cause, and that if the water continued to leak even after fixing the faucet, it would likely be a problem with the dishwasher. (Honestly, if the sink faucet were the primary cause, he could have just told me to call someone else to fix it first.) However, since it was Sunday and the hardware store probably wouldn't be open, he said he would go to the hardware store on Monday to buy a new faucet, fix the dishwasher, and then check for the secondary cause. He came back to our house the next day at 10 am. After fixing the sink faucet and checking for a mechanical defect, it turned out that wasn't the case. Thanks to him, we now have a dishwasher and can use a new sink faucet. I am so sorry and grateful. I was so touched that you checked everything so thoroughly and took responsibility until the very end. My Dear itself is great, but thanks to the technician, I gained trust in Coupang Rocket Installation. I don't know if you will read this, but thank you so much! Downsides. Actually, there are no downsides yet. I already knew how to use a dishwasher to some extent from looking at the one at my company, even though the brand is different. Also, I don't have the confidence to remove food particles stuck in the dishwasher myself. So, I rinse out solid food scraps and chili powder with water beforehand (and plan to continue doing so). Electricity costs. I think it might be cheaper than my own labor. If any downsides arise, I will come back to write about them. +++++. 26.03.25. Downsides. I think I understand what you mean about it not drying. Since I only eat dinner on weekdays, I use the dishwasher in the evening as well. I run the dishwasher tonight, and then tomorrow evening, I take the dishes out, organize them, and put in the dishes from that day's dinner. However, I discovered a downside over the weekend. Since I eat breakfast, lunch, and dinner with the kids on the weekend, I ran the dishwasher around lunchtime. When I went to clean up in the evening, I found there was still moisture, making it difficult to tidy up immediately. Because we have a dishwasher, we don't use a separate drying rack; we just use the cup holder on the sink. So, it is a bit of a shame that I can't clean up right away. At work, I use an LG dishwasher, and even that wasn't completely dry after it finished. The difference is that the LG dishwasher leaves just a few droplets of water, whereas the My Dear dishwasher leaves water dripping down. The cleaning power is good, so I am satisfied!

I'm using it in the multi-purpose basket! 3. It's wider and bigger than I expected. The dishwasher at work is an 8-place setting, and the one at my grandmother's is a 12-place setting, but there wasn't as big a difference as I thought. So I assumed the My Dear dishwasher would be the same. But wow. The interior space is spacious, and the bottom is tall, so pots slide right in. I can actually use quite a lot of space. Especially when you eat a meal, you need spoons, plates, rice bowls, soup bowls, and pots—you know, that's a lot. I thought I could just use the top or bottom sections! + The sink area looks much cleaner. Since there is no drying rack, the cooking space at the sink has expanded, which I love so much! Rocket Installation, Rocket Delivery. I seriously got a +10,000,000 rating for Rocket Installation. I had planned to install the dishwasher first and then insert the pantry once the technician left. He also checked to see if the drain pipes or other wires were interfering with it. He tested everything and left. Right after he left, I ran the dishwasher and took a nap. When I woke up, the living room was flooded. Shocked, I called the technician to let him know, and he came right away! He said that after checking, the sink faucet seemed to be the primary cause, and that if the water continued to leak even after fixing the faucet, it would likely be a problem with the dishwasher. (Honestly, if the sink faucet were the primary cause, he could have just told me to call someone else to fix it first.) However, since it was Sunday and the hardware store probably wouldn't be open, he said he would go to the hardware store on Monday to buy a new faucet, fix the dishwasher, and then check for the secondary cause. He came back to our house the next day at 10 am. After fixing the sink faucet and checking for a mechanical defect, it turned out that wasn't the case. Thanks to him, we now have a dishwasher and can use a new sink faucet. I am so sorry and grateful. I was so touched that you checked everything so thoroughly and took responsibility until the very end. My Dear itself is great, but thanks to the technician, I gained trust in Coupang Rocket Installation. I don't know if you will read this, but thank you so much! Downsides. Overall performance, I do feel that all the dishes I do wash in the dishwasher do get clean, some remain wet after completion. Purchased from Costco 12.5.25 , first dishwasher was damaged upon arrival , 2nd dishwasher received 1.26.26. Sentence (English): Reason for purchase.
Comments (English): Reason for purchase. I was remodeling my house and redecorating my kitchen, so I really wanted to add a dishwasher. I was hesitant about the design of the previous external dishwasher, but the built-in unit's design was the biggest reason I chose it. The Objet Collection's beautiful colors made it seem like it would blend in well with my kitchen, and since it's an LG product, I felt confident in its reliability. Pros. The built-in unit fits perfectly, making my kitchen look neat and tidy. It blends in naturally without being flashy, which is a huge plus. The color is luxurious, true to the Objet Collection, and it looks even prettier in person. It's easy to use, so even a first-time user could quickly get the hang of it. I'm also very satisfied with its cleaning power. It washes even greasy dishes and pots cleanly, significantly reducing the stress of dishwashing. It's large enough for 14 people, so it's big enough for a family, and only needs to be used once or twice a day. I was able to schedule the installation for a specific date, and a professional installer came out and did a thorough job. He also provided helpful instructions, so I had no worries about using it for the first time. Cons. Since it's a built-in unit, you need to measure the sink exactly before installation. There may be limitations in fitting it into an existing kitchen without remodeling. And the price is not cheap, so I was initially hesitant. Overall, if you're considering a dishwasher during a remodel, this is a truly satisfying choice. I'm very satisfied with the overall design, cleaning power, and ease of use. It makes my kitchen look much neater and my life more comfortable, so I'm confident I made a good decision. I highly recommend this appliance as one you'll use for a long time.

Comments (English): [ Formerly Good Brand in Decline ] || ---------------- || We are not happy with the new dishwasher. We are not happy with the installation.We bought this dishwasher at the end of November, 2025. Our old Bosch dishwasher picked Thanksgiving for its pump to die. It is WiFi connected. I connected it to our network easily enough, but have not enabled any fancy features. The one feature I might want is delayed start. That feature is no longer available from the front panel.The bottom rack is either improperly assembled or badly designed. The dishwasher tips forward if I pull out more than one rack.It needs an anti-tip bar installed. The installers either did not understand or were unprepared. I bought an anti-tip bar, and will have our regular repair company install the dishwasher properly.Or, I may eat the cost of this dishwasher and replace it with another brand, from another store.

Sentence (English): A one-month review of the LG Dios Objet Dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ It's the best ] || ---------------- || A one-month review of the LG Dios Objet Dishwasher. Raising a child has always led to a ton of dishes piling up every day, so I've been considering a dishwasher for a while now. Finally, I installed the LG Dios Objet Collection DUE5BGL1E 14-seater dishwasher. It's been about a month since I started using it, and I'm so happy I didn't wait until now. First of all, the 14-seater dishwasher has ample storage. It's incredibly convenient to be able to load pots and pans all at once, allowing me to collect all the dishes before I need to wash them. Previously, the sink would fill up quickly, but now my kitchen feels much more organized. I'm also very satisfied with the cleaning power. Even greasy dishes and baby food trays are cleaned thoroughly, with virtually no water stains. I also appreciate the dry, fluffy finish after the hot air dryer. I also appreciate the fact that it's rated A-rated for energy efficiency, which means less of a burden on my electricity bill. It's also quieter than I expected, so I can run it at night without any problems. My thoughts after a month of use: - The 14-seater dishwasher has ample storage. - Satisfied with both cleaning and drying power. - Grade 1 rating, so less of a burden. - My kitchen is much cleaner. The only downside was that it took some getting used to how to efficiently arrange the dishes. However, after using it a few times, I quickly got the hang of it. Overall, I feel like my quality of life has definitely improved. I feel like this is a highly satisfactory product for those looking to reduce the stress of dishwashing.

Sentence (English): One-line Review: The finishing touch to your kitchen interior, a must-have for households of 1 to 4!
Comments (English): One-line Review: The finishing touch to your kitchen interior, a must-have for households of 1 to 4! Pros: Bespoke's signature clean and sophisticated colors elevate the kitchen atmosphere. Being a countertop model, it is easy to install and does not take up much space. User Experience: Although it looks small for a 6-place setting, the internal basket design is efficient, so it is sufficient for washing dishes from a typical meal. The high-temperature direct water spray cleans even burnt-on rice effectively. The noise level is quieter than expected, so it is not a bother even when running it at night. Unlike lower-priced models from other companies, the dishes feel fluffy and sanitized after drying, giving me peace of mind. The automatic door opening feature ensures hygiene. Conclusion: Highly recommended for those who want both a beautiful design and convenience. Your quality of life improves dramatically with reduced dishwashing time. #SamsungElectronicsEventEntry

Sentence (English): I am a dishwasher enthusiast & technician and I always tell people that the fancier dishwashers are a waste of money.
Comments (English): [ Impressive performance & quiet ] || ---------------- || I am a dishwasher enthusiast & technician and I always tell people that the fancier dishwashers are a waste of money. They rely on diverter motors which often fail as well as tiny circulation motors. This dishwasher is excellent, strong performance and very quiet. It runs all spray arms at once instead of having a diverter to split them up, which takes more cycle time. This dishwasher has cleaned everything I've loaded into it, I do not pre rinse at all I only scrape solids off. All the cycles work well, and they aren't as long as I expected them to take. There are many illegitimate reciews here from people who A. Don't know how to load the dishwasher Or B. Don't use the correct cycle and don't run the hot water at the sink before starting it up or using poor performing detergents or not using rinse aid and blame it on the machine. This dishwasher also has an excellent quality detergent dispenser. Many new dishwashers including whirlpool use a sliding door dispenser and during the pre rinse water floods into the dispenser which mixes with the detergent and the detergent prematurely leaks into the pre wash leaving almost nothing left in the dispenser for the main wash, but not with this dishwasher! It has the older style flip open door, and a nice foam seal that keeps all the detergent in the dispenser until the board gives it the ok to open, big plus! The motor is quiet, the drain pump is quiet, the machine dries perfectly on just the regular heat dry setting I haven't ever had to use the extended dry, using hi temp wash or sanitize or both doesn't make the cycle take too much longer and I'm extremely satisfied, it's a simple, reliable, well built dishwasher I only wish it had a roof spray arm & a third rack as well as cup shelves for the top rack, but I can install some myself. Absolutely adore this machine. Excellent quality too for a plastic tub dishwasher

Sentence (English): First, I was using a Samsung desktop 6-seater dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ As expected, home appliances are made by large companies! ] || ---------------- || First, I was using a Samsung desktop 6-seater dishwasher. I already knew dishwashers were convenient, but I hadn't even used it for two years, so I was considering replacing it. The reason I initially bought a 6-seater was because, for a family of three with a baby, a 12-seater was too big, and I felt like I'd end up with a pile of dishes waiting to be washed. I didn't want to mess with the sink or anything like that, since I wasn't sure when I'd be moving. So, I made my decision, but as I used it, I realized the desktop took up too much space, making cooking in the kitchen cramped and frustrating. And as I used it, I realized I should have bought a 12-seater. With all the pots and large cooking utensils, a 6-seater felt incredibly small. So, without hesitation, I sent it to Carrot and bought this. Delivery: I ordered it on Saturday, and on Sunday, I received a call to schedule the delivery. They came to remodel the kitchen on Monday, and due to the installer's circumstances, the installation was scheduled for Tuesday! The repair and installation technicians were friendly and thorough. There was a defect in the product. However, after the technician left, I tested it out, and while it was running, the machine kept making a "ding ding ding ding ding" noise. I'd read all the reviews before buying, so I thought, "Oh, I've got a bad drawing too!" The exchange process was complicated, and I was at a loss. I recorded the noise on video and contacted the technician right away. He checked with the office and got back to me right away. He said it was defective and would be exchanged immediately, possibly as soon as the item arrived this week or next week at the latest. He also said I could continue using the defective product in the meantime. He then called me on Thursday to discuss the exchange, and I received a replacement product on Friday morning. If you confirm a defective product, contact the technician on the same day, and the installation team will respond immediately, ensuring a quick response. He also said that if it's left for more than a day, it will be passed on to Samsung's after-sales service, which can be time-consuming and complicated. Be sure to test the product immediately upon receiving it, and if there's a problem, contact the installer and they'll respond immediately! Cons. Even with the same product, the automatic door opening after washing can vary! The customer said the door on the one I exchanged didn't open as well. I tested it and found no mechanical noise issues, but the door was so stubborn that I'll have to use it for another 10 days to decide whether to exchange it. The technician also saw it and confirmed the issue, so I think they took care of it right away. Satisfaction. I've used a dishwasher that dries with hot air, but this one doesn't, so I was worried the dishes wouldn't dry properly. It dried so well that I didn't have to worry about that! Sentence (English): Recently, my dishwasher broke down, so I urgently purchased an LG Electronics Dios Objet Collection 12-seater dishwasher.
Comments (English): Recently, my dishwasher broke down, so I urgently purchased an LG Electronics Dios Objet Collection 12-seater dishwasher. I was excited because it had a design that perfectly complemented my kitchen interior, and the delivery was quick and easy to install. Initially, I slowly learned how to use it by reading the user manual, but I was immediately satisfied with it. Pros: First of all, the design is really beautiful. True to the clean Objet Collection design, it made the entire kitchen feel much more organized. The built-in design makes for great space utilization, and the luxurious colors really lifted my spirits. The dishwasher's cleaning power is truly outstanding. It perfectly cleaned even greasy frying pans and dried-on food. Even glasses were cleaned and sparkled. It was a real hit. The pleasant, subtle scent left behind afterward was also very satisfying. It's virtually silent. Even at night, you won't notice it. It's just white noise, allowing the family to relax. Being able to clean up whenever you want is incredibly convenient. Storage is surprisingly good. Perhaps because it's designed for 12 people, it's roomy enough to hold pots, plates, and cups, and the well-designed basket structure makes dish organization easy and stable. A minor drawback is that sometimes the dishwasher doesn't dry completely after the cycle ends. However, this can be resolved by letting it air dry a little longer, so it wasn't a major issue. Its cleaning power is excellent anyway. Overall, I'm very satisfied with my purchase of this dishwasher. I love everything about it, from its design to its performance, and it's a definite time-saver in my busy schedule. Sentence (English): I brought this dishwasher a month ago from Lowe's.
Comments (English): [ Poor installation ] || ---------------- || I brought this dishwasher a month ago from Lowe's. The Lowe's installer put it in on February 10th. He had problems with the installation and took an hour and a half to complete the job. He left without turning on the machine. I told him I would clean up the wood shavings so that he could go. After he left, I turned the machine on to check to see if it was going to work and noticed a knock when the pump engaged to drain.Throughout the machine's cycle run, whenever the pump turns on there's always a knock. Also, the machine is attached at the top of the cabinet opening using two heavy screws which split the wood on both sides during installation. Sooner or later, these attachments will fail. On the inside of the machine, the upper left track is extremely tight without any play. The right side is normal with a small amount of play. The upper water outtake apparatus closes with difficulty, very stiff, as though it has pressure pushing from the left side. Again, it appears that the machine was pushed too tightly against the left cabinet during installation and is affecting the dishwasher performance. Also, when checking the machine's balance with a level, three sides are good. The fourth side (left side) is out of balance. The installer had problems connecting the drain hose, finally giving up after trying for 45 minutes. He announced the hose was too short, went to his truck, brought back a black hose, which looked like an automotive hose and completed the installation. He used four extra large radiator clamps to attach the drain hose. Smaller clamps and a semi-clear corrugated, polypropylene hose would have been much more appropriate. The drain boot attachment look like the original piece, old and worn. It should have been replaced. So far, that's all I have. Lowe's says I can only rely on the Factory Warranty.Cie la vie

Sentence (English): Disclaimer: The following is my opinion based on prior experience and preference of function I have come to value in an appliance of this type.
Comments (English): Disclaimer: The following is my opinion based on prior experience and preference of functionality I have come to value in an appliance of this type. Your experience and preferences of features may be different. Our prior dishwasher (a Kenmore) developed a sudden leak; a repair technician said it would cost almost as much to fix as to replace; he recommended a KitchenAid. Despite my less than stellar prior experience with this brand (seemed overpriced to malfunction as soon as it did by leaking underneath and causing floor damage that cost a lot more to fix than the new dishwasher to replace it), I took the advice. I figured he was more familiar with what they are like now than me, and I needed something in a hurry. That was a mistake.The delivery guys were great and got it set up well. Positive things about this KitchenAid: It does clean the dishes well, as did the less expensive Kenmore that bit the dust. Not positive things about this KitchenAid: It is not as quiet as was the Kenmore, but that's kind of splitting hairs. I do not find the layout of the compartments to be as functional as the Kenmore, or other dishwashers I have had with a 3rd shelf. The first thing I did was remove the cover over the compartments for holding silverware. These require the silverware pieces all to be handle down, mouth-feed end up, so you have to remove the pieces by taking hold of the part that will go into people's mouths. Since the idea is to make these surfaces as antiseptic as possible, one could use food service type gloves to remove the silverware each time, but why not just stack them in the partitions so you can pick them up lower on the handles and avoid contact on the "head" of every piece? By removing the slotted cover, you can do that.The "third shelf" on top is a waste of space. If it were not for a removable insert that was included, the shelf would be worthless for my intended use; as it is, it makes about a third of the top shelf available for inserting small pieces that don't fit securely on either of the larger shelves below, so the top shelf is about 2/3 worthless. I'm going to have to find out if I can get 2 more (likely outrageously priced) inserts to accomplish what was built in to every other dishwasher I have had with a top third shelf: a place to put smaller objects so they would not fall through and end up on the bottom of the unit by the end of the wash cycle. The cheaper Kenmore also had a timer that displayed how much time was left in the cycle, so I could gauge if it's feasible to add any extra items that may have been used after the dishwasher was started, like a mug from an after-meal cup of coffee, or a small plate and extra silverware from a desert. Without the timer it can be a crap shoot. The cheaper Kenmore had such a timer, which was helpful. And if the argument is that this is a "cheaper" model of a KitchenAid, its original price was listed at $1,349, marked down to $949, still way more than the Kenmore that was about $500 (about five years ago) and lasted over 4 years. A $1,349 dishwasher should have timer as an included feature. Despite all of the above, if the unit ends up lasting for over 5 years (6 or more would be a bonus), I might end up thinking it was a good value, because so many appliances made now turn out to be junk with built in obsolescence. When they are promoting $200 warranties to extend coverage for after only I year, you know that they know it's junk.

Despite my less than stellar prior experience with this brand (seemed overpriced to malfunction as soon as it did by leaking underneath and causing floor damage that cost a lot more to fix than the new dishwasher to replace it), I took the advice. I figured he was more familiar with what they are like now than me, and I needed something in a hurry. That was a mistake.The delivery guys were great and got it set up well. Positive things about this KitchenAid: It does clean the dishes well, as did the less expensive Kenmore that bit the dust. Not positive things about this KitchenAid: It is not as quiet as was the Kenmore, but that's kind of splitting hairs. I do not find the layout of the compartments to be as functional as the Kenmore, or other dishwashers I have had with a 3rd shelf. The first thing I did was remove the cover over the compartments for holding silverware. These require the silverware pieces all to be handle down, mouth-feed end up, so you have to remove the pieces by taking hold of the part that will go into people's mouths. Since the idea is to make these surfaces as antiseptic as possible, one could use food service type gloves to remove the silverware each time, but why not just stack them in the partitions so you can pick them up lower on the handles and avoid contact on the "head" of every piece? If it were not for a removable insert that was included, the shelf would be worthless for my intended use; as it is, it makes about a third of the top shelf available for inserting small pieces that don't fit securely on either of the larger shelves below, so the top shelf is about 2/3 worthless. I'm going to have to find out if I can get 2 more (likely outrageously priced) inserts to accomplish what was built in to every other dishwasher I have had with a top third shelf: a place to put smaller objects so they would not fall through and end up on the bottom of the unit by the end of the wash cycle. A $1,349 dishwasher should have timer as an included feature. Despite all of the above, if the unit ends up lasting for over 5 years (6 or more would be a bonus), I might end up thinking it was a good value, because so many appliances made now turn out to be junk with built in obsolescence. Sentence (English): I upgraded to a built-in dishwasher when I moved.
Comments (English): [ Built-in dishwasher that's easy to install while moving ] || ---------------- || I upgraded to a built-in dishwasher when I moved. I'm a working mom in my 30s with two daughters, ages 8 and 6. When I moved, I also had to buy new kitchen appliances, and Coupang was a great place to buy them. I previously used a six-person standing dishwasher, but this time I switched to an LG built-in dishwasher. The on-site installation and delivery options were convenient. Since I needed the installation to fit my moving schedule, I liked being able to set a specific date. While I couldn't specify a time, I could still set the installation on a specific date, which was convenient. I also appreciated that the installer came to my house, so I didn't have to worry about installation. The dishwasher seats 12, which is definitely roomy. It holds a lot more than my previous six-person dishwasher. It's much easier to load and run dishes after meals. There's even room for the kids' dishes. It's easy to use and easy to operate. The button layout is simple, so I quickly got used to it. I just need to press the cycles I use most often. It washes dishes thoroughly, even with greasy dishes. I liked the clean, crisp feel after washing. I'm satisfied with the reduced dishwashing burden since switching to this dishwasher. I think this would be a good fit for those who are installing a built-in dishwasher when moving, or those looking to upgrade from a six-person dishwasher to a larger capacity. It was also a convenient purchase for those who need to accommodate installation schedules. Summary: A built-in dishwasher that's great for moving.

Sentence (English): We bought this dishwasher to replace the old GE that was installed when the house was built in 1984.
Comments (English): [ PROBLEMS GALORE ] || ---------------- || We bought this dishwasher to replace the old GE that was installed when the house was built in 1984. My thought was that if the old GE dishwasher lasted that long, then I couldn't go wrong with a new one. Not so, unfortunately.When this appliance was installed, something was done incorrectly so that it would not dry the dishes when the cycle completed. Even after waiting several hours after cycle completion, the dishes were still wet, and there was no heat whatsoever coming from the dishwasher. I called to have it looked at, and found that a fan or heating element was to blame. The problem was rectified and I thought that was going to be the end of my problems. Again, not so.Over the past 3 years, various problems arose requiring a repair person. First, the appliance would not turn on no matter which buttons were pushed. The problem appeared to be a software update that was required. After the software was updated, there was no problem. I asked the repair person if software updates could be done over the air, you know, like my cell phone. No, a repair person has to come out to do it. I asked if this was something that was a free service or did I have to pay for that in addition to the house call. Yes, was the response they are not free, except there was no charge for this specific update. Now I was worried that this fancy dishwasher was going to be a problem with software updates.The next problem to arise was, again, having to do with the control panel. Again, no response to any key presses. I called again to have it looked at. This time, I was told that the circuit board was possibly bad. Sentence (English): I've now had this dishwasher 3 mos.
Comments (English): [ it's worth the upgrade ] || ---------------- || I've now had this dishwasher 3 mos. It gets the dishes exceptionally clean every time, I mean seriously clean (following their instructions). Best feature it is quiet and I mean quiet, run it anytime it won't disrupt the scenario. The new technology of how it dries is spot on put the plastics on bottom rack no problem. The only time water remains on plastic is if you do not cant them. This dishwasher dries above and beyond expectations. Recommend use the top rack for utensils it works well. I've used the remote starting and the concentrated wash in a sector, it's worth setting it up. Installing instructions were easily understood (would have had it "professionally" installed but was told it would be a week) needed it before that. Bottom line this dishwasher is worth it albeit pricey. The dent in the wallet was worth every penny. Why 4 stars- it did not have the user manual with it (had to down load it on website). What good is having a top notch machine if you do not know how to use it.
